title: Operational Excellence Lead I (PharmD)
description:
Overview

Replimune’s mission is to revolutionize cancer treatment with therapies designed to activate a powerful and durable full-body anti-tumor response, boldly transforming cancer care because patient’s lives depend on it.

At Replimune, we live by our values:

United: We Collaborate for a Common Goal.

Audacious: We Are Bold.

Dedicated: We Give Our Full Commitment.

Candid: We Are Honest With Each Other.

People are at the center of everything we do, and when it comes to our employees, we make it personal. With a deep sense of purpose, a strong and evolving culture, a competitive and forward-looking total rewards program, everyone at Replimune has a unique opportunity to impact on the lives of patients, caregivers and themselves.

Join us, as we reshape the future.

Position Summary

Replimune is seeking a highly motivated and proactive Operational Excellence Lead I (PharmD) to serve as a field-based subject matter expert responsible for supporting the successful integration of RP1 into treatment centers across the United States. Working as a member of the Operational Launch Excellence Team, this individual will work in close collaboration with field sales and other staff to partner with treatment centers to assess operational readiness, facilitate Operational Workflow Meetings, identify implementation barriers, and optimize workflows to ensure successful adoption of RP1.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with multi-disciplinary care teams including but not limited to, medical oncology, pharmacy, nursing, interventional radiology, and practice leadership to help sites across the US operationalize RP1 and deliver positive treatment experiences. This individual will also contribute to the development of best practices, site readiness tools, and operational playbooks that can be scaled across the organization and adapted to future product launches.

This is a field-based position that involves a substantial travel commitment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Site Readiness & Launch Execution

  • Conduct site readiness assessments for targeted treatment centers in area of professional expertise.

  • Support implementation of the RP1 Site Readiness strategy.

  • Partner with treatment centers to evaluate operational workflows, identify potential gaps, and develop action plans – with a particular emphasis in area of professional expertise.

  • Ensure sites are prepared to successfully operationalize RP1 prior to first patient treatment.

  • Assist sites in navigating the unique operational requirements associated with RP1, including product storage, thawing, scheduling, administration logistics, and multidisciplinary care coordination.

2. Operational Workflow Meetings

  • Help facilitate Operational Workflow Meetings with Medical Oncologists, Surgical Oncologists, Interventional Radiologists, Oncology Nurses, Advanced Practice Providers, Pharmacists, Practice Administrators and the Scheduling and Operations Personnel

    • In particular, take a leading role in preparing and facilitating meetings and/or workstreams in area of professional expertise

  • Conduct workflow mapping exercises to identify potential barriers and opportunities for optimization.

  • Document site decisions, action items, and follow-up requirements.

  • Provide recommendations based on established best practices and experience across treatment centers.

  • Execute timely follow-up with sites to ensure implementation plans are progressing as intended.

3. Best Practice Development & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Develop expertise in operationalizing RP1 as an intratumorally administered oncolytic viral therapy, especially in area of professional expertise.

  • Become proficient in:

    • RP1 storage and handling requirements

    • Ultra-cold chain logistics

    • Product thawing and pharmacy workflows

    • Injection scheduling considerations

    • Live-virus biologic handling procedures

    • Interventional Radiology workflows

    • Multidisciplinary patient care coordination

  • Capture operational learnings and insights from treatment centers.

  • Identify emerging best practices and opportunities for process improvement.

  • Contribute to the creation of workflow playbooks, readiness assessments, meeting materials, and implementation tools; take a lead role in area of professional expertise.

  • Share learnings and best practices internally with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Training, and other functional teams.

Account Support & Relationship Management

  • Establish credibility and trusted partnerships with treatment center stakeholders, especially in area of professional expertise.

  • Support treatment centers throughout onboarding and early adoption phases.

  • Monitor site progress and identify opportunities for workflow optimization.

  • Promote consistency in implementation approaches across treatment centers with similar characteristics while adapting to site-specific constraints.

Qualifications Operational Excellence Lead I (PharmD)

Required

  • Bachelor's Degree required, advanced PharmD degree or related studies preferred.

    • Board Certified Oncology Pharmacist (BCOP) certification is a plus

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare operations, oncology, specialty therapeutics, or clinical practice.

    • 2+ years of experience in clinical pharmacy in an academic or community setting is strongly preferred.

    • Experience launching oncology products in a specialty or hospital-based environment is strongly preferred.

    • Experience in logistics/receipt of cold chain product, including but not limited to, confirmation of temperature monitoring data and correct storage of product in an institutional setting.

  • Understanding of applicable regulatory guidelines and regulations and knowledge of IRT/IVRS/IXRS functions, or similar inventory management system.

  • Demonstrated success working with multidisciplinary healthcare teams.

  • Experience supporting oncology and/or specialty treatment centers.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare operational workflows.

  • Advanced facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills; in particular, ability to facilitate workstream meetings related to area of professional expertise in an industry setting.

  • Strong project management and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Ability to travel extensively (50-75%).

Salary Range

Replimune is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. For this role, the anticipated base pay range is $170,000 to $218,000. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the selected candidate’s unique set of qualifications, skills, and experience. Our current organizational needs also play a part in determining your final offer.

At Replimune, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The selected candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Replimune also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays including year-end shutdown.

About Replimune


Replimune Group, Inc., headquartered in Woburn, MA, was founded in 2015 with the mission to transform cancer treatment by pioneering the development of a novel portfolio of oncolytic immunotherapies. Replimune’s proprietary RPx platform is based on a potent HSV-1 backbone intended to maximize immunogenic cell death and the induction of a systemic anti-tumor immune response. The RPx platform is designed to have a unique dual local and systemic activity consisting of direct selective virus-mediated killing of the tumor resulting in the release of tumor derived antigens and altering of the tumor microenvironment to ignite a strong and durable systemic response. The RPx product candidates are expected to be synergistic with most established and experimental cancer treatment modalities, leading to the versatility to be developed alone or combined with a variety of other treatment options. title: 스토어 코워커 (세일즈: 주32시간, 1년 6개월 계약직) - 이케아 강동점
description:
우리는 어떤사람과 일하고 싶나요?

*본 포지션은 1년 6개월 육아휴직 대체 계약직 포지션이며, 세일즈팀 내에 서재 및 어린이 구역에서 근무합니다. (HFB 3,9)

• 영업과 목표 달성, 이케아 고객에게 최고의 경험을 선사하고자 하는 열정을 가진 사람
• 이케아 가치가 본인의 가치를 정확히 반영할 수 있는 사람
• 사람들의 주거 환경과 홈퍼니싱에 관심이 있는 사람
• 빠른 템포의 미래 지향적인 환경에서 일하는 것을 좋아하는 사람
• 적극적인 영업과 고객 지원을 위한 올바른 태도와 행동을 지닌 사람
• 고객의 행동에 대한 이해를 갖춘 사람
• 이케아 방식의 판매에 대한 지침을 이해하고 적극 사용할 수 있는 사람
• 서비스 상품을 포함한 이케아 제품에 대한 지식을 갖춘 사람
• 기본적인 제품 진열 노하우를 갖춘 사람
• 적극적인 영업 능력을 갖춘 사람
• 고객 만족을 창출하는 능력을 갖춘 사람
• 자신감 있게 사람들에게 다가가 공손하고 친근하게 대화를 거는 능력을 갖춘 사람

책임과 의무

• 도움이 필요한 고객에게 적극 접근해 적절한 질문을 통해 요구 사항을 파악하고 고객의 기대를 뛰어넘는 최적의 솔루션을 조언합니다.
• 다양한 이케아 영업 및 커뮤니케이션 채널을 사용하는 방법과 다양한 고객을 상대하는 노하우를 파악합니다.
• 담당 구역을 청결하고 정돈된 상태로 관리하고 가격을 올바르게 기재하며 충분한 재고 물량을 유지합니다.
• 고객에게 긍정적인 쇼핑 경험을 선사하기 위해 항상 이케아 표준을 준수합니다.
• 이케아 제품에 대한 열정을 가지고 제품의 기능과 이점을 적극적으로 고객 및 동료와 나눕니다.
• 매장과 부서의 실행 계획을 이해하고 부서의 목표를 달성하는 데 기여합니다.
• 이케아 매장에서 제공되는 모든 서비스를 적극적으로 제안하여 고객이 충분한 정보를 바탕으로 합리적인 선택을 할 수 있도록 만족스러운 쇼핑 경험을 제공합니다.
• 매장 전반에서 계획된 판촉 활동의 실행을 리딩하거나 지원합니다.
• 재고가 많은 제품 / 주력 제품 판매에 적극 힘써 수익성을 유지하면서 매출을 극대화 합니다.
• 판매 공간을 분석 및 조정하여 제품 물량을 충분하게 확보합니다.
• 이케아의 지속 가능한 성장과 환경에 기여합니다.

한 팀이 되어 함께하기

이케아는 프로세스 중심 조직으로서 비즈니스를 개발하고 여러 부서와 함께 성과를 창출합니다.
이케아는 모든 접점에서 많은 사람들에게 우수한 품질의 제품을 쉽고 편리하게 쇼핑할 수 있는 경험을 제공하는 데 주력하고 있습니다.

문의나 도움이 필요하세요? 연락해 주세요!

내부 지원자의 경우 지원 전 라인 매니저와 얘기해주세요. 채용 과정의 일환으로 라인 매니저에게 레퍼런스 확인이 진행될 예정입니다.
만약 이전에 이케아에서 근무한 경험이 있다면, 지원서에 이 사실을 명시해야 합니다. 저희는 또한 귀하의 이전 이케아 조직에 연락하여 추천서를 요청할 수도 있습니다. 면접은 순차적으로 진행될 예정이며, 적합한 지원자가 발견될 경우 명시된 마감일보다 일찍 채용 절차가 종료될 수 있음을 알려드립니다.

채용과 관련하여 궁금한 사항은 recruit.ikea.kr@ingka.ikea.com 로 문의 해 주세요.

채용 시 참고사항

당사는 「국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률」 및 「장애인고용촉진 및 직업재활법」에 따라 보훈 대상자와 장애인에게 채용 전형에서 우대 혜택을 제공합니다. 관련 법령에 따른 대상자는 지원 시 해당 사항을 기재해 주시기 바랍니다.

최종 합격하여 채용이 결정된 경우 근로관계 개시일부터 3개월의 *시용기간이 진행됩니다. 다만, 1회에 한해 3개월 이내에서 연장될 수 있습니다. (*시용기간은 수습기간을 의미)

서류 반환 정책

* 본 고지는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』 제11조 제6항에 따른 것입니다.
* 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.

* 채용서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용서류 반환청구서[채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제3호 서식]를 작성하여 당사 이메일 recruit.ikea.kr@ingka.ikea.com 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.

* 당사는 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

title: Project Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Project Engineer to join our team supporting the DOE's Y-12 National Security Complex! This position is full-time and will be based out of Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

Responsibilities

  • Provide Project Engineering support and coordination for commercial, infrastructure, production modernization, and production stockpile projects.

  • Support the planning, design, procurement, and implementation of new machine tools, production equipment, and infrastructure upgrades.

  • Provide technical integration, leadership, and direction to multidisciplinary engineering teams supporting high-profile plant initiatives.

  • Plan and direct engineering activities throughout the project lifecycle, from initial scope development through implementation.

  • Develop and maintain detailed project design scopes, engineering budgets, schedules, and technical requirements.

  • Apply applicable ASME NQA-1 Nuclear Quality Assurance requirements to engineering activities performed within nuclear facilities.

  • Coordinate engineering activities with Production, Maintenance, Project Management, Construction, Startup, and Project Controls organizations.

  • Integrate and coordinate internal and external technical resources to meet project objectives and schedules.

  • Monitor engineering progress against approved project schedules, budgets, and milestones and implement corrective actions when necessary.

  • Identify and resolve technical, design, schedule, and coordination issues that could impact project execution.

  • Provide engineering leadership for complex, high-priority, and time-sensitive plant initiatives.

  • Ensure engineering deliverables meet applicable technical, quality, safety, and project requirements.

Requirements

  • Education & Years of Experience – Bachelor’s Degree in technical or engineering discipline from an ABET-accredited institution and 10+ years of relevant engineering/project engineering experience.

  • Citizenship – To be considered, you must be a United States (U.S.) citizen due to the federal nature of the work.

  • Clearance – To be considered, you must be able to obtain and maintain a government issued clearance, if needed.

  • Demonstrated experience with project planning, design, implementation, and technical coordination.

  • Experience leading and coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Ability to develop and manage project scopes, engineering budgets, schedules, and technical requirements.

  • Experience supporting equipment/machine tool installations, infrastructure upgrades, or production modernization projects.

  • Knowledge of ASME NQA-1 Nuclear Quality Assurance requirements and their application in nuclear facilities.

  • Experience coordinating with Production, Maintenance, Construction, Startup, Project Management, and Project Controls organizations.

  • Ability to monitor engineering progress, schedules, and milestones and implement corrective actions when required.

  • Strong technical leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively coordinate internal and external technical resources.

Desired Skills

  • Active or very recently active DOE “Q” Clearance or DoD “Top Secret” Clearance, desired.

  • Experience working in nuclear, DOE, manufacturing, or highly regulated industrial environments preferred.

About the Site

The NNSA's Y-12 National Security Complex, in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, is the nation’s only source of enriched uranium nuclear weapon components and provides enriched uranium for the U.S. Navy as well as excels in materials science, precision manufacturing, and stores enriched uranium. Y-12 supports efforts to reduce nuclear proliferation risk and performs work for other government agencies ().

ABOUT GEM

GEM Technologies, Inc. (GEM) is an award-winning federal contractor with more than 30 years of experience providing environmental, construction, facility management, and technical services to federal agencies, state and local governments, and commercial organizations. Founded in 1994 as a nuclear engineering firm to support federal operations in East Tennessee, GEM has since expanded into a nationwide, multi-disciplinary provider with over 270 employees and a diverse portfolio of contracts in the environmental, nuclear, and defense sectors. Some reasons to join GEM are:

  • Our philosophy – We believe in the power of effective collaboration and recognize that good partnerships are the building blocks to success.

  • Our relationships – Partnering with federal clients, we solve complex problems, exceed expectations, and advance critical missions.

  • Our team – We are committed to managing a cohesive workforce and cultivating a supportive workplace for our employees on contracts and in-office.

  • Our community involvement – Supporting our communities, we invest time and money in local schools and non-profit organizations.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

GEM’s offered compensation is dependent on candidates’ education, qualifications, and relevant years of experience. To recruit and retain our exceptional staff, we offer the opportunity to elect benefit packages that best suit our employee’s needs; this includes, but is not limited to, a competitive Salary, Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (including HSA & PPO options), Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Life Insurance, and a matching 401(k) Retirement Plan.

Please Note: With the exception of mandated state requirements, GEM does not publish salary information on external job boards; as such, most ranges listed are estimates made by vendors and not actual salary ranges.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

GEM Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

title: Installation Specialist - Salt Lake City, UT
description:
About SpotOn

We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh*t about helping restaurants succeed.

  • Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users

  • Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users

  • Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running

We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.

The Installation Specialist ensures restaurant sites are fully prepared for successful POS installations through comprehensive virtual assessments, on-site readiness checks, and installation execution. This could include, but is not limited to, performing site surveys, installing POS hardware virtually or onsite, and delivering staff training. Serving as a technical escalation point, this role troubleshoots complex infrastructure issues, mentors junior specialists, and contributes to process and SOP improvements. With deep restaurant operations knowledge and strong technical expertise, the Specialist drives installation efficiency, enhances client readiness, and promotes long-term business success.

Responsibilities

Conducting Virtual Site Surveys

  • Conduct comprehensive virtual assessments, including complex or escalated restaurant sites.

  • Validate readiness of wiring, electrical infrastructure, networking, and internet performance.

  • Perform advanced diagnostics (traceroutes, port checks) and document infrastructure gaps or risks.

  • Provide technical guidance to clients and vendors to resolve issues.

  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Technicians, and Engineering to ensure installation success.

  • Lead follow-ups to confirm remediation and support junior specialists through training and knowledge sharing.

  • Recommend improvements to survey tools, templates, and internal processes.

  • Maintain detailed records in internal systems, including photos, diagrams, and survey outcomes.

Conducting Installations

  • Install and configure POS hardware, including workstations, printers, pin pads, cash drawers, switches, routers, and firewalls.

  • Complete cabling, patching, and connectivity setup.

  • Deliver onsite training and live support for staff and management.

  • Implement menu/system updates and reporting configuration.

  • Conduct pre- and post-installation tasks, site readiness checks, and troubleshooting.

  • Lead follow-ups with clients to ensure smooth transitions and adoption.

  • Travel regularly to client sites as required.

Quality Assurance

  • Deliver high-quality, accurate work and outcomes by consistently adhering to documented processes, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and checklists.

  • Review and verify outcomes before submission to maintain consistency and high-quality standards.

  • Identify and address process gaps or errors to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of networking infrastructure, including low-voltage cabling, routers, switches, and Wi-Fi optimization.

  • Skilled in advanced network testing (speed, latency, DNS) and translating findings into actionable guidance for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical abilities, with experience resolving escalated technical issues.

  • Hands-on experience with restaurant POS systems, multi-terminal deployments, and technology installations across QSR, full-service, or franchise environments.

  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-site projects independently and mentor junior team members.

  • Experience conducting client-facing walkthroughs, training staff, and communicating technical information clearly via Zoom or in person.

  • Familiarity with restaurant operations, POS hardware/software, menus, modifiers, and reporting workflows.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, CRM platforms, ticketing systems, and travel/expense management.

  • Excellent organizational, multitasking, and communication skills with a professional approach under pressure.

  • Demonstrated success in 50+ POS installations or comparable technical deployments.

  • Background in customer-facing roles, IT support, implementation, or technical project leadership within restaurants, retail, or multi-location businesses.

Previous Experience

  • 2-3 years of restaurant and/or technical support experience

  • Experience in fintech or SaaS environments preferred.

Education / Professional Training

  • A high school diploma or GED is required.

  • An Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Networking or Systems Administration, Engineering Technology, Business Administration, Hospitality Management (with strong technical acumen) or a related field is preferred.

  • An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 50-75%, including local and out-of-state travel with overnight stays as needed.

Languages & Level of Proficiency

  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)

Compensation

  • Our pay range is $20.00 - 25.00 per hour for this role.

  • Offers will be reflective of the candidate’s location and experience.

Benefits

At SpotOn, we put people above everything else. We’re known for our innovative software and technology solutions, but we stand out because of the hardworking humans behind the tech. title: Service Desk Officer
description:
About RSPCA Queensland

For more than 140 years, RSPCA Queensland has been a leading animal welfare charity, dedicated to improving the lives of animals – whether domestic, farmed, or native. We care for over 42,000 animals annually, relying on the generosity of animal lovers like you to fund 91% of our life-changing services.

Our Purpose: We exist for animals to live better lives.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Service Desk Officer to join our Information & Technology team and provide responsive, practical and people-focused IT support across RSPCA Queensland.

As one of the first points of contact for IT support, you’ll help our people navigate everything from everyday technical hiccups through to more complex Level 1 and Level 2 issues. You’ll troubleshoot, problem-solve, set up equipment, manage user access and make sure our team members feel supported along the way.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of variety. While you’ll be primarily office-based, you’ll support users both onsite and remotely and may occasionally hit the road to provide support across our shelters, op shops and other RSPCA locations throughout Queensland.

If you enjoy solving problems, genuinely like helping people and can translate technical jargon into language anyone can understand, this could be a great fit.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced and customer-focused Service Desk Officer who combines strong technical capability with a genuine desire to help people.

You’ll be a confident problem-solver who can troubleshoot Level 1 and Level 2 IT issues, manage competing priorities and take ownership of requests through to resolution. Just as importantly, you’ll be approachable, patient and able to explain technical information clearly to people with varying levels of IT confidence.

You’ll enjoy working as part of a collaborative IT team, while being comfortable working independently and using your judgement to resolve issues, escalate when needed and keep things moving.

Above all, you’ll bring a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and understand that great IT support isn’t just about fixing technology – it’s about creating a great experience for the people using it..

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Be a first point of contact for IT incidents, service requests and technical enquiries.
  • Diagnose and resolve Level 1 and Level 2 hardware, software, mobile, peripheral, video conferencing and connectivity issues.
  • Install, configure and deploy hardware, devices and software across the organisation.
  • Log, prioritise, track and manage support tickets through Jira, working within agreed service levels.
  • Support Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure, Exchange, SharePoint and other core business technologies.
  • Manage user accounts and access, including onboarding and offboarding activities.
  • Escalate more complex issues to the appropriate support teams, providing clear and accurate documentation.
  • Assist with IT asset deployment, tracking, maintenance and returns.
  • Keep users informed throughout the support process with clear, timely and helpful communication.
  • Work with third-party vendors and service providers when additional support is required.
  • Contribute to knowledge articles, support documentation and improvements to the way we deliver IT services.
  • Provide occasional onsite support across RSPCA Queensland locations as required.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 2-5 years’ experience in IT service desk, desktop support or a similar role, providing Level 1 and Level 2 support.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows, Active Directory, Azure, Exchange and SharePoint.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, device and connectivity issues.
  • Experience using IT service management/ticketing systems, with an understanding of SLAs and ITIL practices.
  • Strong problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to take ownership of issues through to resolution.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, with a knack for making technical information easy to understand.
  • Strong organisation and prioritisation skills in a fast-paced support environment.
  • A collaborative, proactive approach and willingness to share knowledge across the team.
  • A relevant IT qualification is desirable, but practical experience is highly valued.
  • A current Australian driver’s licence and access to a vehicle for occasional site visits.
  • A genuine connection to RSPCA Queensland’s purpose and animal welfare.

Why Join Us?

  • Comprehensive Support: Enjoy 8 weeks of paid parental leave, flexible working arrangements, study leave, and even leave for your furry companions. We also provide access to counselling and mental health services.
  • Employee Perks: From free on-site parking to exclusive discounts, novated leases, and 50% off Royal Canin pet food, we’ve got you covered! You can also adopt a new furry friend with free adoption options.
  • Professional Growth: Access expansive learning and development programs to help you elevate your career and skill set.
  • Purpose-Driven Impact: Be part of a mission-driven organisation where every task makes a tangible difference to animal welfare.

At RSPCA Queensland, every role contributes to a better future for animals.

Interested?

If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you, apply today!

Successful candidates will be required to undergo a Police Check for the safety and well-being of the community, staff, and animals. A pre-employment medical assessment may also be required.

title: Chemical Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Chemical Engineer to join our team supporting the DOE's Y-12 National Security Complex! This position is full-time and will be based out of Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Mechanical Project Design group at the Oak Ridge Y-12 Plant.

  • Provide process design support to the Lithium Processing Facility Project at the Plant.

  • Support includes participation in designs ranging from scope definition, feasibility and conceptual studies, and preliminary/detailed designs.

  • Perform tasks including flowsheet development (block diagrams, process flow diagrams, and P&IDs), analyses and calculations, reports/studies and Process Descriptions preparation.

Requirements

  • Education & Years of Experience – Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering and 10+ years of relevant experience.

  • Citizenship – To be considered, you must be a United States (U.S.) citizen due to the federal nature of the work.

  • Clearance – To be considered, you must be able to obtain and maintain a government issued clearance, if needed.

  • Experience providing chemical/process engineering support for complex industrial, nuclear, manufacturing, or DOE-related projects.

  • Strong experience with process design through multiple project phases, including scope definition, feasibility studies, conceptual design, preliminary design, and detailed design.

  • Proficiency in developing and reviewing:

    • Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs)

    • Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)

    • Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)

    • Process flowsheets

  • Experience performing chemical/process engineering analyses and calculations.

  • Ability to prepare engineering reports, technical studies, calculations, and Process Descriptions.

  • Knowledge of process equipment, piping systems, instrumentation, valves, and process controls.

  • Ability to interpret and review engineering drawings, specifications, design criteria, and technical documentation.

  • Experience working within a multidisciplinary engineering/design team, including coordination with mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and controls, and other engineering disciplines.

  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and engineering judgment skills.

  • Ability to support projects in a highly regulated environment, preferably DOE, nuclear, chemical processing, or similar facilities.

Desired Skills

  • Active DOE "Q" Clearance or Active DoD "Top Secret" Clearance, preferred.

  • Experience with lithium processing, chemical processing facilities, or nuclear material processing is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with DOE facilities and Y-12 engineering/design requirements is preferred.

About the Site

The NNSA's Y-12 National Security Complex, in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, is the nation’s only source of enriched uranium nuclear weapon components and provides enriched uranium for the U.S. Navy as well as excels in materials science, precision manufacturing, and stores enriched uranium. Y-12 supports efforts to reduce nuclear proliferation risk and performs work for other government agencies ().

title: Compute Engineer
description:
As an Operational Technology (OT) Compute System Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and supporting OT-specific enterprise systems and applications. These business-critical systems play a key role in enabling operational technology services for both the end customer and the wider business.

This role involves ensuring that all systems under the compute remit remain compliant, secure, and aligned with industry standards. You will contribute to the resolution of infrastructure issues and help deliver new solutions as required by the business.

What you’ll be doing as a Compute System Engineer
  • Support the ongoing maintenance and lifecycle management of existing OT compute infrastructure, including patching and license management.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand and deliver new technical solutions, including cloud-based technologies, in support of future needs.
  • Act as a key point of contact for incident response, demonstrating strong problem-solving skills and the ability to act quickly under pressure.
  • Assist in the design and implementation of infrastructure changes, including both high-level and low-level technical designs.
  • Ensure domain system security compliance through audits, reviews, and proactive management.
  • Support the delivery of regular updates across the full technology stack, including application, OS, BIOS, and hypervisors.
  • Administer and support a wide range of enterprise technologies, including Active Directory, SCCM, VMware, Symantec Endpoint Protection, Dell OpenManage Enterprise, Canonical patching tools, NTP, PKI/certificates, and hybrid Azure environments.
  • Contribute to the integration and evolution of Industry 4.0 solutions within the OT compute domain.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours on-call rota (following probation and prerequisites) to provide emergency support for critical OT systems.
  • Support and collaborate with other technical teams in delivering infrastructure improvements and new deployments.
  • Stay current with industry best practices and demonstrate the ability to act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) within the compute domain.
  • Engage in personal development and training to ensure capability across required technologies.
  • You will be required to be a part of our mandatory standby for our 24/7 support in this role.
Base location – Hybrid – Clearwater Court, Reading.
Working pattern – 36 hours Monday to Friday.

What you should bring to the role
  • Higher education qualification (HNC or equivalent experience) in an engineering or IT discipline.
  • Proven experience in maintaining, patching, and supporting infrastructure and enterprise systems.
  • Security clearance to SC level.
  • Familiarity with enterprise application administration, including Active Directory, SCCM, VMware, AV software, and Azure cloud services.
  • Knowledge of IP communications and networking, including LAN and WAN.
  • Understanding of industry-specific SCADA systems, or willingness to learn. Proficient scripting skills using PowerShell or similar.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; confident in dealing with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven decision-making skills and the ability to balance operational, commercial, and customer needs.
  • Understanding of IT and OT delivery approaches. (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall, Lean).
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented and able to work under pressure.
Desirable qualifications and experience
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) – Server, SQL, SCCM.
  • Microsoft Applied Skills – Administer Active Directory Domain Services.
  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals and/or Azure Administrator Certification.
  • Experience in scripting and automation using PowerShell.
  • VMCE certification or hands-on experience with Veeam Backup & Replication (or similar).
  • Symantec Endpoint Protection (SEP) administration certification.
  • Prior experience working within the utility industry or a large-scale enterprise environment. (>20,000 devices)
  • Experience with stakeholder analysis and managing relationships across multiple technical and business teams.
  • Security Clearance: CTC (Counter Terrorist Check) clearance is desirable. Where this is not already held, it will be obtained as part of the role.
What’s in it for you?
  • Competitive salary up to £66,435 per annum, depending on experience.
  • Car allowance - £4,500.
  • Annual Leave - 26 days holiday per year, increasing to 30 with the length of service. (plus bank holidays).
  • Performance-related pay plan directly linked to both company and individual performance measures and targets.
  • Generous Pension Scheme through AON.
  • Access to lots of benefits to help you take care of yourself and your family’s health and wellbeing, and your finances – from annual health MOTs and access to physiotherapy and counselling, to Cycle to Work schemes, shopping vouchers and life assurance.
Find out more about our benefits and perks (Please note different T&Cs apply if on secondment)

Who are we?
We’re the UK’s largest water and wastewater company, with more than 16 million customers relying on us every day to supply water for their taps and toilets. We want to build a better future for all, helping our customers, communities, people, and the planet to thrive. Real purpose, real support, real opportunities. Come and join the Thames Water family. Why choose us? Learn more.

title: Senior Communications Program Specialist #1853860
description:
About NDi:

Network Designs, Inc. (NDi) is a leading Federal contractor that specializes in designing, developing, and delivering information technology and network solutions for government customers. We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Communications Program Specialist to join our team in support of the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Office of Information & Technology (AIT). The specialist will provide strategic and tactical communications services that promote AIT's value, improve the user experience, and support the timely and accurate dissemination of information through coordinated executive, web, and operational messaging.

This role requires an experienced communications professional who can independently gather and clarify requirements, translate technical information into clear and actionable content, develop executive-ready communications products, and guide those products through established FAA review, approval, and publication processes with minimal Government rework.

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication skills, strategic thinking abilities, and a proven track record of developing and implementing effective communication strategies. The ideal candidate will also possess a strong understanding of IT infrastructure and the ability to translate technical concepts into accessible and compelling messaging.

Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • This position is remote, candidate must reside in one of the following states: AL, AZ, DC, FL, GA, ID, MD, MS, NJ, NC, OK, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WV

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, such as Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Business Administration, Information Technology, or IT Management.
  • Minimum of ten years of progressive communications experience, including strategic communications experience in corporate and/or Government environments.
  • Demonstrated executive-level writing experience supporting senior leaders, including executive correspondence, briefings, and talking points.

  • Experience supporting technology communications, IT service communications, or technology adoption and rollout initiatives.

  • Ability to coordinate with graphic-design resources and integrate approved visual assets into communications products.
  • Knowledge of governance-based routing and approval processes, including version control and auditable documentation of reviews, approvals, and publication activity.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a related field, such as Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Business Administration, Information Technology, or IT Management.
  • Previous experience supporting FAA or Department of Transportation organizations.
  • Familiarity with FAA or DOT internal communications channels and governance processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently gather and clarify communications requirements from Government stakeholders and translate them into actionable strategies, plans, and products aligned with AIT goals.
  • Develop executive-ready and tactical communications, including BLUFs, executive summaries, briefings, talking points, FAQs, email broadcasts, announcements, newsletters, job aids, web content, and campaign materials.

  • Develop communications plans, messaging frameworks, audience and stakeholder analyses, channel strategies, content calendars, and rollout approaches.
  • Develop and optimize content for FAA digital platforms, including FAA's external and internal-facing websites, and web-based newsletters, using applicable user-experience, web-design, and digital-communications practices.
  • Translate complex technical and subject-matter-expert input into clear, actionable information for technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Coordinate with Government stakeholders, technical teams, subject-matter experts, and graphic designers to develop content and integrate approved, accessible visual assets.
  • Manage communications through the established intake, drafting, validation, review, approval, routing, publication, and dissemination process.
  • Ensure products comply with FAA writing, branding, accessibility, quality-control, template, and version-management requirements.
  • Track suspense dates, reviews, approvals, publication status, and release channels while maintaining an auditable record and providing requested status updates and metrics.
  • Support AIT events by preparing agendas, presentations, invitations, and event content; coordinating technical logistics; tracking attendance; capturing questions and answers; and documenting outcomes.
  • Provide on-demand communications support for executive taskers, emerging priorities, time-sensitive announcements, special projects, Project Communication Plans, and ad hoc reports.

Our corporate benefits include 401(k) retirement matching, paid leave, paid holidays, and health and wellness programs. title: Rural Health Transformation Program Analyst- Term Limited
description:
Department Information


STATE OF COLORADO RESIDENCY REQUIRED AT TIME OF APPLICATION

Note: This announcement may be used to fill multiple openings.


Envision Yourself Working at HCPF

The State of Colorado strives to create a Colorado for All by building and maintaining workplaces that value and respect all Coloradans through a commitment to equal opportunity and hiring based on merit and fitness. The State is resolute in non-discriminatory practices in everything we do, including hiring, employment, and advancement opportunities.


The Department of Health Care Policy & Financing (HCPF) oversees and operates Health First Colorado (Colorado's Medicaid Program), Child Health Plan Plus (CHP+), and other state public health programs for qualified Coloradans. Our mission is to improve health care equity, access and outcomes for the people we serve while saving Coloradans money on health care and driving value for Colorado.


We are looking for a Program Analyst - Term Limited to join our Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) Division of the Office of Medicaid & CHP Behavioral Health Initiatives & Coverage (BHIC)!


The RHTP Division of BHIC is responsible for the full lifecycle management of the State’s RHTP initiative, encompassing program planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting functions. The division ensures the State’s compliance with the statutory and federal requirements of Section 71401 of Public Law 119-21 and the RHTP Notice of Funding Opportunity. Its work focuses on strengthening rural health system capacity through grant administration, provider technical assistance, workforce and service delivery initiatives, and evaluation of system transformation outcomes. The division manages partnerships with subrecipients, contractors, and federal agencies to ensure that investments support sustainable access to high-quality care in rural communities.


We are committed to increasing the diversity of our staff and providing culturally responsive programs and services. Therefore, we encourage responses from people of diverse backgrounds and abilities.


As part of the State of Colorado, HCPF offers a competitive benefits package:

  • PERA retirement benefits including PERA Defined Benefit Plan, PERA Defined Contribution Plan, plus 401K and 457 plans

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage

  • Automatic Short-Term and Optional Long-Term Disability Coverage

  • Life and AD&D Insurance

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

  • Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) job protection and State of Colorado Paid Family Medical Leave (PFML)

  • 11 Paid Holidays Annually and Accrued Annual and Sick Leave

  • Accrued Sick Leave for State of Colorado Temporary Employees

  • Flexplace and Flextime work arrangements

  • Variety of discounts on services and products available through the State of Colorado's Work-Life Employment Discount Program

  • Free RTD EcoPass to all eligible State Employees

  • Reduced college tuition through CSU Global

  • Credit Union of Colorado Membership Eligibility

  • Some positions may qualify for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. For more information, go to .


We are onboarding new employees using a hybrid approach. The Department supports flexible work arrangements. Depending on the business need and description of the position, we have options that range from hybrid to full-time in the office. Specific discussions about the schedule will be discussed during the offer stage.


**Please note - equipment provisioning and certain onboarding tasks will take place in person, in our downtown Denver office, on the first day of employment.**


Description of Job

What You’ll Be Doing as Program Analyst:

  • Lead performance management for Colorado’s Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP), developing statewide performance standards, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), evaluation methodologies, dashboards, reporting processes, and continuous quality improvement strategies.
  • Turn complex data into actionable insights by analyzing and integrating information from multiple sources, identifying trends and emerging risks, measuring program outcomes, and developing recommendations that support program, policy, and executive decision-making.
  • Build compelling dashboards, visualizations, and executive-level reports that clearly communicate RHTP performance, outcomes, trends, risks, and opportunities to Department leadership, CMS, policymakers, and other stakeholders.
  • Lead RHTP performance reporting and data quality efforts, including CMS reporting, performance measure development, data validation, quality assurance, benchmarking, and the establishment of consistent analytical and reporting standards.
  • Shape how RHTP performance is measured and improved by providing technical leadership and consultation to Department staff, grantees, contractors, evaluators, and external partners on performance measurement, evaluation, analytics, reporting, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Manage the RHTP Evaluation Contract and help guide the five-year evaluation strategy, overseeing contractor performance, timelines, deliverables, methodologies, outcome measures, and compliance with contractual, state, and federal requirements.
  • Serve as a technical expert on program evaluation, analytics, and performance measurement, reviewing evaluation products for quality and methodological rigor and translating findings into practical recommendations for leadership and program partners.
  • Lead and support high-priority strategic initiatives and special projects, conducting research, policy analysis, and data analysis in response to executive, legislative, Joint Budget Committee, CMS, and other time-sensitive requests.
  • Collaborate across the Department and with external partners to translate performance data, evaluation findings, and program outcomes into clear reports, presentations, public-facing communications, and stakeholder materials.
  • Support RHTP implementation throughout Colorado, including approximately 10% travel to rural and frontier communities for grant oversight, site visits, stakeholder engagement, program monitoring, and other implementation activities.

This is a term-limited position with funding through September 30, 2030.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights

Residency Requirement:

This posting is only open to residents of the State of Colorado at the time of submitting your application.


Class Code & Classification Description:

H1C4XX
Analyst IV

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

There are two ways to qualify for this position:


Option 1:

Experience Only:

Seven (7) total years of professional experience in performance management, program evaluation, data analysis, or an occupational field closely related.


Option 2:

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in public health, public policy, program evaluation, statistics, data analytics, economics, business administration, health administration, or a field of study related to the work assignment
AND
three (3) years of professional experience in performance management, program evaluation, data analysis, or an occupational field closely related.


Appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis. Relevant education will be calculated as the following:

  • An associates will count as two years of experience

  • A bachelors will count as four years of experience

  • A masters degree will count for six years of experience

  • A doctorate or juris doctorate degree will count for seven years of experience


Note: Per the Job Application Fairness Act, you may redact information that identifies your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution on your transcripts.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Previous relevant professional state experience

  • Masters degree in public health, public policy, program evaluation, statistics, data analytics, economics, business administration, health administration

  • Professional Experience with:

    • Developing and implementing performance management, monitoring, evaluation, and/or continuous quality improvement frameworks

    • Developing, calculating, interpreting, or validating performance and program outcome measures

    • Conducting quantitative and qualitative data analysis, including analyzing complex datasets, identifying trends, validating data, and translating findings into actionable recommendations

    • Designing or implementing program evaluation methodologies

    • Managing complex, long-term projects or contracts with defined timelines, deliverables, performance expectations, and reporting requirements

    • Presenting complex analytical or performance information to executive leadership, policymakers, and technical and non-technical stakeholders

    • Providing technical assistance, consultation, training, or coaching to staff, contractors, grantees, or other partners in an area of subject matter expertise


Skills to Support Success:

  • Excellent customer service

  • Problem solving

  • Ability to be self-motivated and self-directed, while possessing the ability to work in a team environment

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple tasks

  • Ability to adapt to changing federal or programmatic requirements while maintaining continuity of operations

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across cross-functional and interdisciplinary teams

  • Ability to serve as a subject matter expert and provide coaching, guidance, and technical expertise to others within your area of specialization


Definition of Professional Experience: Work that involves exercising discretion, analytical skill, judgment, personal accountability, and responsibility for creating, developing, integrating, applying, and sharing an organized body of knowledge that characteristically is uniquely acquired through an intense education or training regimen at a recognized college or university; equivalent to the curriculum requirements for a bachelor's or higher degree with major study in or pertinent to the specialized field; and continuously studied to explore, extend, and use additional discoveries, interpretations, and application and to improve data, materials, equipment, applications and methods.

Conditions of Employment:

  • All positions at HCPF are security sensitive positions and require that the individuals undergo a criminal record background check as a condition of employment.

  • Employees who have been disciplinary terminated, resigned in lieu of disciplinary termination, or negotiated their termination from the State of Colorado must disclose this information on the application.

  • This is a term-limited position with funding through September 30, 2030. Successful candidates will sign a Waiver of Retention Rights and normal personnel rules regarding retention will not apply. Additional information regarding term-limited positions can be found here.


Appeal Rights:

If you receive notice that you have been eliminated from consideration for this position, you may file an appeal with the State Personnel Board or request a review by the State Personnel Director.


An appeal or review must be submitted on the official appeal form, signed by you or your representative. This form must be delivered to the State Personnel Board by email (dpa_state.personnelboard@state.co.us), postmarked in US Mail or hand delivered (1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver CO 80203), or faxed (303.866.5038) within ten (10) calendar days from your receipt of notice or acknowledgement of the department’s action.


For more information about the appeals process, the official appeal form, and how to deliver it to the State Personnel Board; go to ; contact the State Personnel Board for assistance at (303) 866-3300; or refer to 4 Colorado Code of Regulations (CCR) 801-1, State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures, Chapter 8, Resolution of Appeals and Disputes, at under Rules.

Supplemental Information

How to Apply (Please Read Carefully)

Please note that ONLY your State of Colorado job application will be reviewed during the initial screening; if you submit a resume and cover letter, they will be reviewed in later stages of the selection process. Therefore, it is paramount that you clearly describe all your relevant experience on the application itself. Applications left blank or marked "SEE RESUME" will not be considered.


Your application will be reviewed against the minimum qualifications for the position. If your application demonstrates that you meet the minimum qualifications, you will be invited to the comparative analysis process, which is described below.


Comparative Analysis Process

The comparative analysis process will consist primarily of a review of applications against the minimum and preferred qualifications of this position. Applications will be reviewed in comparison to all others in the applicant pool in order to identify a top group of candidates who may be invited for a final interview. Depending on the size of the applicant pool, additional selection processes may be utilized to identify a top group of candidates. Applicants will be notified of their status via email. Failure to submit properly completed documents by the closing date will result in your application being rejected.


ADAAA Accommodations: The State of Colorado believes that equity, diversity, and inclusion drive our success, and we encourage candidates from all identities, backgrounds, and abilities to apply. The State of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer committed to building inclusive, innovative work environments with employees who reflect our communities and enthusiastically serve them. Therefore, in all aspects of the employment process, we provide employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, medical condition related to pregnancy, creed, ancestry, national origin, marital status, genetic information, or military status (with preference given to military veterans), or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.


The Department of Health Care Policy & Financing is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment, including completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or to perform essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to our ADAAA Coordinator, Anupreet Kaur, at anupreet.kaur@state.co.us.

title: Associate Director, D&A Strategy
description:
Job Description

The Associate Director for Oncology Insights and Engagement - Precision Medicine will reside within the Digital Human Health (DHH) Global Oncology Marketing Engagement team. The team provides strategic thought‑partnership by understanding precision medicine priorities, developing and delivering strategic insights and analytics, and activating digital products / services to inform executive decision making and increase commercial rigor across key stages of asset development, launch planning, and market shaping.

The role will serve as the primary point of contact for US and Global Oncology Marketing team, responsible for developing and communicating data‑driven, actionable insights that enhance that enhance patient and market understanding to inform precision medicine strategy. The role will also be responsible for quarterbacking the end‑to‑end delivery of DHH and IT capabilities, and leading the activation of insights, analytics, and digital products (incl. generative and agentic AI) to support precision medicine priorities.

Critically, the Associate Director will work closely with cross‑functional DHH and IT teams (e.g., market research, forecasting, AI capabilities, data strategy) to proactively orchestrate the planning and delivery of complex analytics assessments, as well as for activation and end‑to‑end delivery of DHH and IT capabilities. The role requires connecting the dots across these capabilities to ensure that insights generation is integrated, scalable, and aligned to business priorities.

The role will also work closely with cross-functional teams across Enterprise (e.g., clinical and discovery, medical affairs, competitive intelligence) to inform executive decision making and increase commercial rigor through all phases of pipeline asset development.

The individual in this role will be an independent contributor or lead a small global team.

Key Responsibilities:

Partnership with US and Global marketing

  • Act as a key point of contact for US and Global Precision Medicine Marketing teams, establishing credible relationships and being their strategic thought‑partner on relevant topics.

  • Translate business needs and priorities to build structured analytical plans and hypotheses that answer business questions by providing actionable insights

  • Effectively communicate advanced analytics to stakeholders to inform business decisions.

Strategic insights & analytics for Precision Medicine

  • Develop and own commercial insight generation strategy and roadmap for precision medicine, applying the latest technological advancements such as AI to strengthen efficiency & productivity

  • Analyze data across disparate databases/sources (e.g., biomarkers data, testing data, epidemiology data, claims/EMR data and other sources across US and exUS) to develop insights that inform commercial business questions (e.g., understanding patient journey, referral patterns, patient / HCP segmentation and market sizing)

  • Ensure analytical rigor, consistency, and transparency of assumptions and methodologies.

  • Integrate insights across primary market research and secondary data sources (e.g., biomarkers data, testing data, epi data, claims / EMR data, syndicated reports, ATUs, demand research)

  • Develop clear, compelling data stories that translate analytics into business recommendations.

Cross‑functional collaboration and orchestration

  • Quarterback DHH and IT capabilities end‑to‑end, ensuring integrated delivery across insights, analytics, and technology functions. Connect the dots across DHH and IT capabilities to deliver cohesive, decision‑ready outputs rather than siloed analyses.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross functional teams with competencies in market research, forecasting, data science, data strategy, competitive insights, marketing operations, medical & clinical backgrounds, while ensuring the right capabilities are engaged at the right time.

  • Align cross‑functional teams on scope, methodology, timelines, and outputs to ensure high‑quality, integrated insights delivery.

Innovation and Capability Acceleration

  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in analytical methodologies to bring new ideas forward (including application of AI) that will enhance analytic capabilities of the organization.

  • Contribute to innovative experiments, specifically to idea generation, idea incubation and/or experimentation, identifying tangible and measurable criteria to make meaningful improvements to the business processes and strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to embed next‑generation analytics and digital capabilities into pipeline and launch strategy development.

Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of Specialists and Senior Specialists (on-shore and off-shore), providing guidance on best practices in data analytics, modeling and data visualization, through the scope of a project.

  • Foster a team culture where team members are focused on ‘things that matter’, empowered to act with urgency, actively innovate and are supported through continuous learning and feedback process.

  • Also lead cross-functional insights teams, comprised of cross-functional stakeholder groups across DHH and other parts of the organization.

Education Requirements:

  • BS (or equivalent) in Data Science, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Decision Science, Marketing, Engineering, Public Health, or equivalent scientific/ commercial discipline.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing, data insights and analytics (e.g., advanced or predictive analytics, secondary data analytics, forecasting, market research), strategic planning, or related roles within pharmaceutical, biotech, consulting, or healthcare industry.

  • Knowledge in mining patient medical claims/EMR data with a strategic mindset and proven record of being able to produce actionable business insights that drive positive commercial results.

  • Strategic thinking skills with strong ability to consolidate and synthesize primary/secondary data insights.

  • Self-motivated, proactive mindset, and learning agility.

  • Ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.

  • Story-telling and executive presence with senior leaders.

  • Effective interpersonal skills, communication skills, and stakeholder management, including experience collaborating in a matrixed organization and ability to align stakeholders on data-driven decisions.

  • Strong business acumen and consultative skills, with proven ability to comprehend business processes and commercial strategies in detail and translate these into detailed business standards/questions that power analytics.

  • Effective organizational and project management skills to work effectively across the organization and manage a team of business analysts and data scientists efficiently and effectively.

  • Innovative thinking with affinity toward experimentation and appropriate risk-taking, including curiosity about how agentic AI and automation can enhance commercial analytics and insight generation.

  • Awareness of the opportunities, limitations, and responsible use of AI (including agentic AI) in a regulated environment (e.g., data privacy, validation of AI-generated outputs).

  • Prior hands-on experience working with healthcare data, especially EMR/EHR, Claims Data (e.g., IQVIA APLD) and various data offerings.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Experience in Life Science or consulting industry.

  • Prior experience in Oncology / Precision Medicine

  • Global experience, specifically as it pertains to data and analytics

  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, PharmD, PhD) appreciated but not required.

Required Skills:

Business Acumen, Business Acumen, Business Agility, Business Analysis, Business Decisions, Business Metrics, Business Needs, Competency Management, Corporate Decision Making, Cross-Functional Project Management, Data Analysis, Data Science, Demand Management, Executive Leadership, Executive Presence, Ideation, Industry Trend Analysis, Innovation, Insight Generation, Learning Agility, Managing Ambiguity, Requirements Management, Sourcing and Procurement, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Planning {+ 2 more}

title: Principal Product Manager, Data Platforms
company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
location: San Francisco, California, United States of America
description:
Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

  • Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
  • Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
  • Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Ad & Data Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms.

About the Role

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own the Data Growth Platform end to end: the platform and its architecture, the quarter-over-quarter improvement of its core capabilities, the expansion of the platform into One Disney use cases across every segment, and the marketing outcomes it delivers.

The seven workstreams that make up the platform, data pipelines and sharing, audience analytics and modeling, identity and household resolution, governance automation, audience creation and management, centralized and federated activation, and measurement and optimization, currently run across Corporate Brand, Ad Sales, Disney Experiences, Streaming, enterprise data science, and multiple engineering squads. You are the single product owner who makes them behave as one platform.

This is a builder-operator role with unusual breadth. You will set the vision and own business outcomes, but you will also be in the data model, the identity match rates, the governance workflow, and the campaign results. Success is measured not by what ships, but by what the business wins because it shipped.

Responsibilities

1. The Platform, End to End

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap across data, identity, intelligence, and activation — and sequence it so each milestone delivers standalone business value rather than infrastructure alone.
  • Own the full product surface: the cross-segment data model and data sharing architecture, identity and household resolution, the governance layer and data contracts, audience creation, centralized and federated activation, and campaign measurement.
  • Be the accountable owner across a matrix: engineering squads, Corporate Brand, Ad Sales, Disney Experiences, enterprise data science, Privacy, Legal, and Data Governance. You unblock; you do not escalate.
  • Hold the line on privacy and governance as a first principle, not a gate at the end. Consent enforcement, tagging and masking, GDPR and CCPA policy, and lineage are product requirements you own alongside engineering and Legal.
  • Make build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls explicit across the vendor landscape, cloud data warehousing, ML and analytics tooling, reverse-ETL activation, marketing clouds, identity and enrichment providers, and data cataloging, and own the evaluation and funding case for third-party enrichment.
  • Guard the reuse principle. The platform succeeds by extending what Disney already has. Resist rebuilds; productize common integrations and patterns so the next use case is cheaper than the last.

2. Improving the Platform Quarter Over Quarter

  • Set objective measures, not deadlines. Establish a quarterly operating rhythm with a small number of measurable platform goals, a published scorecard, and an honest retrospective on what moved and what did not.
  • Own and improve the core platform metrics: audience development cycle time, audience analytics project throughput, activation volume, identity and household match coverage, data freshness, activation success rate, share of governance requests auto-approved, and time-to-first-value for a new team onboarding.
  • Close the known gaps. Profile-level data across the streaming services remains incomplete, and household resolution depends on privacy clearance for the deterministic householding solution, with third-party household IDs as a partial fallback. Own the plan, the sequencing, and the fallback.
  • Drive self-service. Push conversational and AI-assisted audience analysis to the point where a marketer can size and build an audience without filing a ticket, and mature it from prototype to production quality.
  • Fund and defend platform debt paydown so the cost of each incremental use case falls every quarter.

3. Unlocking New Use Cases

  • Make the platform the default growth layer across Entertainment and Streaming, ESPN, Disney Experiences, Consumer Products, Studios, and Ad Sales, not a tool serving one org.
  • Land the foundational use cases and turn each into a reusable pattern: incremental audience activation, lapsed subscriber re-engagement, content and creative personalization by franchise affinity, enterprise synergy and suppression, cross-business engagement modeling, and guest next-best-action.
  • Get the first real activations live and instrumented so the platform generates its own performance data, the single most important unlock in front of it today.
  • Partner deeply across business units. Understand each segment's goals, data, constraints, and incentives, and design solutions that serve more than one of them at a time.
  • Navigate the governance frontier with Privacy, Legal, and Data Governance from the start: data contracts, anonymization strategy for onboarding business-unit datasets, permission and consent consolidation, and the household identity rulings that gate the roadmap.

4. Driving Marketing Wins

  • Tie platform capability directly to business outcomes: user-level ARPU, cross-enterprise lifetime value per household, churn reduction, incremental conversion into new lines of business, and marketing spend efficiency.
  • Partner with marketing teams on real campaigns: tentpoles, cruise and park conversion, streaming win-back, and make sure the platform is the reason they performed better.
  • Build measurement and experimentation into the platform so wins are provable and repeatable. Land a platform-native campaign ID stamped upstream in every vendor, then unique reach, frequency, overlap, and incremental lift.
  • Change the narrative. The platform currently reads to leadership as a technology enabler, which understates its role in One Disney. Build the portfolio of documented, attributable wins that reframes it as a growth engine, and use it to secure continued investment.
  • Treat marketers as your primary customer. Know their workflow better than they do, and translate their feedback into the roadmap continuously.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product management, with significant time on data, platform, or marketing technology products serving internal customers.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a platform, vision through operations, with quantified outcomes you can point to.
  • Deep fluency in the marketing data stack: customer data platforms, identity resolution, audience segmentation and activation, campaign delivery, and measurement and attribution.
  • Strong technical depth. You can hold your own on data modeling, warehouse architecture, API contracts, and system trade-offs, and engineers respect your judgment.
  • Working command of privacy and consent as product constraints, GDPR, CCPA, consent enforcement, data masking and tagging, and the approval workflows that surround marketing data.
  • A track record of influencing without authority across large, matrixed organizations with independent P&Ls and competing priorities.
  • Rigorous, metrics-first operating style: you define the measure before you build, and you report against it honestly.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can brief an engineer and an executive on the same problem in the same week and be equally clear.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in media, entertainment, streaming, consumer subscription, or large-scale consumer retail and hospitality.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses, lakehouse analytics platforms, and warehouse-native activation or reverse-ETL tooling.
  • Experience delivering identity resolution or householding at scale, including third-party enrichment and match-rate trade-offs.
  • Experience applying machine learning or LLM-based intelligence to audience analysis, affinity modeling, personalization, or next-best-action.
  • Experience building shared platforms across multiple business units or brands, including the governance and data-contract work that requires.
  • Experience rebuilding credibility for an initiative in a space where prior attempts have created stakeholder fatigue.

#TECHATDISNEY
