Main duties include:

Develop and maintain robust data capture, validation and reporting systems across SAGE ERP, OFX and associated business applications to ensure data accuracy, integrity and timely business insight.

Analyse financial, inventory and operational data to identify trends, variances, risks and opportunities, providing meaningful performance insights and recommendations to support decision-making.

Lead structured investigations into inventory, costing, transactional and system-related discrepancies, working with stakeholders to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Monitor inventory transactions, stock movements, work-in-progress balances and material consumption, identifying anomalies and supporting initiatives that improve stock accuracy and financial control.

Develop, maintain and enhance business intelligence solutions, dashboards, Power BI reports, Power Apps and automated workflows that improve visibility, efficiency and decision-making across the site.

Support ERP enhancements, upgrades, testing activities and system improvements, ensuring that new functionality is effectively validated, documented and adopted by the business.

Act as the site focal point for SAGE ERP and related business systems, providing expert support, troubleshooting system issues and coordinating resolution with internal and external stakeholders.

Maintain and continuously improve reporting processes, including work order analysis, inventory reporting, manufacturing variance reporting and financial performance monitoring.

Collaborate proactively with Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality and Engineering teams to resolve business challenges, improve processes and ensure consistent use of business systems and data.

Promote data-driven decision-making and digital transformation by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and increase automation through technology solutions.

Provide subject matter expertise on ERP systems, inventory management, costing methodologies, reporting tools and business processes to support strategic planning and operational excellence initiatives

Requirements:

Possess a bachelor’s degree in business analysis, engineering or science fields.

Experience with SAGE ERP or similar ERP systems, including inventory, costing, BOMs and master data management.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial, inventory and operational data.

Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) and Microsoft 365 tools.

Good understanding of inventory control, financial reporting, budgeting and variance analysis.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Senior Quality Engineer is a recognized subject‑matter expert and quality leader responsible for ensuring products consistently meet or exceed established quality, reliability, and regulatory standards throughout their lifecycle. This role goes beyond execution and investigation to include strategic thinking, cross‑functional influence, and company‑wide quality decision‑making.

The Senior Quality Engineer proactively drives quality into product design, manufacturing, and supplier processes while also leading complex customer‑facing quality issues, systemic failure investigations, and enterprise‑level corrective and preventative action (CAPA) initiatives. Acting as a mentor, trainer, and advisor, this role establishes best practices, develops organizational capability, and ensures lessons learned are institutionalized across current and future product lines.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex, high‑impact investigations involving customer escalations, systemic field failures, RMAs, and critical non‑conformances using advanced problem‑solving methodologies (8D, 5‑Why, Fishbone, DOE, statistical analysis).

title: GTM Engineering Working Student
description:
Companies have invested billions into ERP systems. And yet, most business decisions are still made the way they were in 1995: on fragmented data, manual exports, and Excel. Finance teams spend five to ten days every month copy-pasting numbers, and four systems show four versions of the same revenue.

AI changes that. At ARC, we are building the AI-native Finance OS: one platform that connects all of a company's systems, answers any question in seconds, finds errors before they cost millions, and automates reporting end to end. Leading Mittelstand companies like Burmester, Pfanner, and Ferrotec, and PE firms like AUCTUS and GENUI, already run their finance on ARC. Finance software is being rebuilt from the ground up this decade, and we intend to win the category.

We are a small, AI-native team in Berlin, fresh off our seed round led by 42CAP, growing revenue 10x since our pre-seed. We build, experiment, and move fast, take real ownership, and keep a low-ego culture.

Aufgaben

You are the GTM Engineering Intern at ARC. While our BDRs are on the phone with CFOs, you build the machine behind them: the automations, data pipelines, and AI workflows that decide who we call, with what message, and when. We sell an AI-native platform, so our own go-to-market has to run AI-native too. You'll build our internal GTM OS from the ground up.

What you'll do

  • Build automated prospecting pipelines: sourcing multi-entity Mittelstand groups and PE-backed companies that fit our ICP, at scale
  • Enrich accounts and contacts with the signals that matter to us: legal entities, ERP landscape, PE ownership, trigger events like ERP migrations or acquisitions
  • Automate outreach workflows across email, LinkedIn, and phone, and keep them personal enough that a German CFO actually responds
  • Connect and orchestrate our GTM stack (HubSpot, Aircall, enrichment and outreach tools) into one system with clean data flowing through it
  • Use AI models aggressively: for research, list building, message drafting, call analysis, and anything else that removes manual work from the pipeline
  • Build dashboards and KPI tracking so we always know what's working in outbound and what isn't
  • Prototype, test, and iterate: your experiments directly shape how ARC's GTM engine works as we scale the sales team

Qualifikation

What makes you a great fit

  • You love building things: with no-code tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents, whatever gets it done fastest
  • You're deep in the modern AI tool stack and use LLMs daily as a matter of course
  • You're analytical and rigorous with data: messy lists and broken syncs bother you until they're fixed
  • You have strong business sense and can think from the prospect's perspective, not just the pipeline's
  • You're hands-on and not afraid of unglamorous work: cleaning a CRM included
  • You communicate well in English; German is a plus since our market is the German Mittelstand
  • You want to work with smart and friendly people with (self-reported) low ego
  • You want to work on-site 5 days a week in our new Berlin office

You may not be a good fit if

  • You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility
  • You're not willing to deeply understand the product and the buyer behind your automations
  • You're only interested in high-level "strategic" work
  • You think GTM engineering means setting up one Zapier flow
  • You've never built anything on your own initiative
  • You prefer working remotely
  • You prefer working with minimal collaboration
  • You want to work a 9-5 job

title: MTS (Delivery)
description:
About AIUC

Our mission is to underwrite superintelligence. We red-team, certify, and insure agents - working with AI category leaders like ElevenLabs, Lovable, Harvey, UiPath, and Fin.


Soon, agents will take on critical work in hospitals, banks and governments. This could create abundance - or go terribly wrong. History teaches us that standards and insurance are capitalism’s best tools for making risk legible and shaping incentives.


We’ve built the gold standard for agent security & reliability, AIUC-1, with 100+ CISOs from the Fortune 1000. Our team comes from Anthropic, McKinsey, METR, Palantir, Amazon - 50% are previous founders. We've raised $55m from Ribbit, First Harmonic, and Nat Friedman. Read more here, here, and here.

The Role

Every AI company that comes to us wants the same thing: proof their agent is safe enough to sell to an enterprise. Getting there means running thousands of evaluations against their live system.

We've now certified the category leaders in every major AI vertical: ElevenLabs (voice), Intercom (customer service), UiPath (workflow automation), Lovable (coding), and more we'll announce soon. No two of those systems look alike: each has its own authentication, its own interface, its own definition of what a failure even looks like. Before we can test any of it, someone has to sit with that customer, understand how their agent actually works, and get it wired into our evaluation system.

We're hiring an engineer to own that work end to end. You'll have your own set of customers within your first weeks, paired with a commercial counterpart on each one.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the path from signed customer to delivered results - scoping what to test, working through their authentication and interfaces, and getting their agent running in our system

  • Build the one-off version when a customer doesn't fit the product yet, and make it work anyway

  • Deliver results directly to the customer and be the person they trust with the technical detail

  • Make the call on whether a customer meets the AIUC-1 standard

  • Work across the widest surface of any role here: our Delivery team, our core engineers, sales, the Standards team (shaping what goes into AIUC-1), and your customer's own engineering team

  • Turn what you learn in the field into the product

That last one is why the role exists. We're building toward a product that runs evaluations end to end without an engineer in the loop. This is a high-agency role: you'll shape what we build next as much as you'll deliver what we've built.

If you're planning to start a company one day, this is a front row seat. You'll work directly with our founders, with founders at the companies we certify, and alongside a team full of ex-founders.

What we're looking for

The job in practice looks like reading someone's API docs, chasing credentials, building integrations into customers' systems and agents. Then evaluating whether those agents behave, and owning the failure modes the evals surface. The person who thrives here has done this work before. What drives them is trust and safety.

To be successful, we think you have:

  • 3-7 years of experience, likely as an early engineer at a startup where you ended up owning customers, or in an integration, solutions, or forward deployed role selling technical products to technical buyers. (Impact matters more than years.)

  • Enough software engineering to build and debug an integration yourself, and the judgment to know when the scrappy version is the right answer

  • Comfort owning a customer relationship directly – scoping the work, setting expectations, and delivering bad news early

  • Customer obsession: their problem is your problem, and you see it through

  • The discipline to turn what you see in the field into something reusable rather than solving the same problem twice

Nice to have

  • Experience founding or co-founding a company

  • Experience with AI evaluations or red-teaming

  • Executive presence with senior stakeholders

Compensation & Perks

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support to San Francisco, where applicable

  • A team dedicated to doing the best work of their lives

Our Values

Strong Back: High standards, keep our promises, work hard

Fast Feet: Experiment, cut scope, take delight in pace

Eyes Up: Feel the AGI across our strategy, teams, and day-to-day work

Open Heart: Say the scary thing, create connection, make room for emotions

title: Pharmacovigilance Scientist
description:
Overview

Replimune’s mission is to revolutionize cancer treatment with therapies designed to activate a powerful and durable full-body anti-tumor response, boldly transforming cancer care because patient’s lives depend on it.

At Replimune, we live by our values:

United: We Collaborate for a Common Goal.

With a deep sense of purpose, a strong and evolving culture, a competitive and forward-looking total rewards program, everyone at Replimune has a unique opportunity to impact on the lives of patients, caregivers and themselves.

Join us, as we reshape the future.

Summary of job description:

PV Scientist will report to Sr Director, Safety Risk Management & PV Sciences and support the medical component of pharmacovigilance activities including: surveillance and monitoring activities providing scientific/clinical PV expertise with a focus on the identification, evaluation and management of safety risks for Replimune developmental and marketed products. PV Scientist will collaborate closely with the safety physician and cross-functional partners to evaluate and actively manage risks in accordance with global regulatory frameworks.

Key responsibilities:

· Perform independently as well as collaboratively, all relevant safety data analyses needed for the Safety Management Team and Safety Committee meetings; ensure adequate documentation, distribution, and archiving of meeting minutes

· Create and maintain an effective signal tracking process that fully documents signaling activities and can be used for regulatory inspection

· Support other function teams for Replimune Investigational products; serve as PV expert and liaise with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Contract Research and other entities as needed

· Contribute to health authority and other safety related query responses

· Support study teams for Replimune investigational products; serve as PV expert and liaise with Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs

· Support PV Medical team for MedDRA and WHO Drug coding review and post marketing case review

· Lead post marketing case query preparation; closely work with PV compliance, PV operations and Medical Affairs

· Become familiar with ARGUS safety database reporting tool and generate line listing to support PV medical team as needed

· Demonstrate knowledge and ensure compliance with current and applicable global PV regulations and guidelines (e.g., CIOMS, EMA, FDA, ICH)

· Ensure compliance with Replimune and GVP&Risk Management policies and procedures

· Support PV Medical for IB update, protocol update, eCRF preparation, and ICF preparation

· Prepares aggregate safety reports (e.g.DSUR, PADER, PSUR), including project management, safety database requests, understanding and writing the content, assimilating information from other groups, and quality checks

· Plans, executes, and documents all literature surveillance activities

· Provide leadership in the development, implementation, and maintenance of robust procedures for the planning, preparation, and submission of high quality safety reports

· Contribute SOP/WI preparation/update

· Support BLA/MAA related and other PV activities such as Risk Management Plan/PV Plan creation and maintenance

· Perform other duties as directed

· Travel on site as required (e.g. site inspection, important meeting)

Qualifications:

• Pharm D, BSN, MD, PhD, MPH, advanced healthcare degree, or equivalent professional experience

• Minimum 4 years pharmacovigilance or research experience

• Thorough understanding of the drug development process and context applicable to safety surveillance activities

• Knowledge of MedDRA terminology and its application

• Knowledge of Clinical/Safety database

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, strong attention to detail, and high performance standards for quality

• Ability to analyze, interpret, and summarize complex clinical and medical literature data

• Ability to prioritize and complete work in a resourceful, self-sufficient manner while maintaining a strong mentality

• Displays ability to understand established procedures to others

• Exhibits comprehension of industry practices and regulations for drug development and pharmacovigilance

• Demonstrates awareness of related medical disciplines and an understanding of general concepts and some experiential detail within those areas

• Processes computer skills to support use of electronic systems and development of writing deliverables

Salary Range

Replimune is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. For this role, the anticipated base pay range is $137,500-178,000. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the selected candidate’s unique set of qualifications, skills, and experience. Our current organizational needs also play a part in determining your final offer.

At Replimune, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The selected candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Replimune also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays including year-end shutdown.

About Replimune


Replimune Group, Inc., headquartered in Woburn, MA, was founded in 2015 with the mission to transform cancer treatment by pioneering the development of a novel portfolio of oncolytic immunotherapies. Replimune’s proprietary RPx platform is based on a potent HSV-1 backbone intended to maximize immunogenic cell death and the induction of a systemic anti-tumor immune response. The RPx platform is designed to have a unique dual local and systemic activity consisting of direct selective virus-mediated killing of the tumor resulting in the release of tumor derived antigens and altering of the tumor microenvironment to ignite a strong and durable systemic response. The RPx product candidates are expected to be synergistic with most established and experimental cancer treatment modalities, leading to the versatility to be developed alone or combined with a variety of other treatment options. title: Detention Facility Officer (FEMALE)
description:
Description

Under general supervision, receives prisoners to process, guard, escort, inspect, and search for unauthorized items in a 24/7 work environment operation.

Examples of Duties

  • Makes thorough searches of prisoners for contraband articles
  • Processes prisoner monies into kiosk, and creates prisoner debit cards.
  • Patrols assigned areas to ensure that prisoners do not escape or have access to unauthorized areas.
  • Inspects prisoners processing area for safety and sanitary conditions.
  • Prepares and maintains reports and logs.
  • Screens visitors for unauthorized items.
  • Oversees interviews between visitors and prisoners
  • Escorts prisoners to scheduled court appearances, and the hospital for treatments.
  • Testifies in court on search procedures and behavior patterns of prisoners
  • Monitors and processes information for the video arraignments and digitized mugging system procedures.
  • Delivers court records and documents to the courts or receiving agency.

Additional Duties

  • Receives detainees from arresting officers and thoroughly searches detainees prior to allowing them to enter Building 500.
  • Enters detainee information into Jail Management System (JMS) or other computer database.
  • Conducts Buccal swab (DNA collection) of detainees who are charged with a felony and do not have DNA on file.
  • Assists with the processing of juvenile detainees.
  • Washes/cleans detainee clothes.
  • Collects detainee property, records property content, places property in property bag and tags the property. Places property in proper storage area. Logs all property in and out of property room.
  • Livescans (fingerprint) and photographs (mugshot) detainees.
  • Assigns detainees to a designated cell or bullpen.
  • Conducts thirty (30) minute cell checks on all detainees by walking through the cellblock area and visually inspecting each detainee to ensure wellbeing.
  • Conducts fifteen (15) minute cell checks on all high-risk detainees or conduct continuous observation if needed.
  • Notifies medical staff and supervision for detainees who are ill, injured, or have pre-existing medical conditions.
  • Feeds detainees at the designated mealtime, accounting for each detainee who receives or refuses a meal and notifies a supervisor of how many meals were served and refused for desk blotter documentation.
  • Notifies supervision of detainee complaints.
  • Documents and notifies supervision of alleged assaults of detainees by other detainees.
  • Documents and notifies supervision when detainees damage City of Detroit property.
  • Prepares detainees for video arraignment.
  • Prepares detainees for conveyance to Wayne County Jail, or other facilities.
  • Ensures that all detainee property is returned to detainees who are being turned over to agencies for outstanding charges in other jurisdictions.
  • Ensures that all detainee property is returned to detainees upon release.
  • Must adhere to the department’s body worn camera (BWC) policy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School graduation or GED.

  • Two (2) years of recent experience in security operations.

Qualifications (preferred):

  • State of Michigan Driver’s License.

Supplemental Information


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • · Knowledge of correctional security techniques and practices.

  • · Knowledge of applicable laws, rules, regulations and orders governing detention facilities.

  • · Knowledge of safety rules and regulations, including first aid.

  • · Skill in the use of a personal computer and related software, a two-way radio, and standard office

  • equipment.

  • · Skill in the use of specialized equipment such as electronic security and monitoring equipment,

  • restraining devices, breath analyzer and metal detectors.

  • · Ability to apply personal defense techniques.

  • · Ability to perform arithmetic computations.

  • · Ability to communicate effectively.

  • · Ability to learn and follow oral and written instructions.

  • · Ability to enforce regulations.

  • · Ability to administer basic first aid.

  • · Ability to learn and understand behavior patterns of incarcerated persons.

  • Licenses, Certifications, and Other Special Requirements:

  • Candidates considered for placement in this classification may be subject to a Criminal Background Investigation based on the requirements of the position.

Physical Demands

Work is performed primarily in indoor and outdoor environments (penal institution). Some work requires travel to other work sites with exposure to seasonal weather conditions. Must be able to perform major duties which involve frequent walking, standing and bending; and restraining prisoners or quelling disturbances.

Work Environment

Most work is performed within a penal institution environment. This position is in a 24/7 operation. A person holding this position is considered an essential worker and is subject to work mandatory overtime (i.e., double shifts) that may occur over a number of consecutive days.

Evaluation Plan
  • Computerized Assessment: 70%
  • Interview: Pass/Fail
  • Evaluation of Training, Experience and Personal Qualifications (T.E.P.): 30%
  • Total Computerized Assessment, Interview and Evaluation of T.E.P: 100%
  • Domicile Credit: 15 Points
  • Veteran Points: 0-15 Points

Position Summary

The Foreman is responsible for leading field crews, ensuring quality workmanship, maintaining job-site safety, and delivering projects on schedule. This role serves as the bridge between field operations and project management, providing leadership, accountability, and support to ensure successful project execution.

The ideal candidate embodies Optiline's core values by leading with integrity, taking ownership of results, developing team members, and maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, supervise, and develop drywall and metal framing crews on commercial and residential construction projects.

  • Mentor Crew Leads, Journeymen, and Apprentices to build future leaders within the organization.
  • Conduct daily crew meetings to communicate goals, expectations, and safety requirements.

Project Execution

  • Read and interpret blueprints, specifications, and construction documents to ensure accurate installation.
  • Coordinate daily manpower, materials, equipment, and workflow to meet project schedules.
  • Monitor productivity and proactively address obstacles that may impact project completion.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, General Contractors, and other trades to maintain project momentum.

Quality & Accountability

  • Inspect work throughout all phases of construction to ensure compliance with company and customer quality standards.
  • Take ownership of project outcomes by identifying issues early and implementing corrective actions.
  • Maintain accurate daily reports, production tracking, manpower logs, and material usage records.
  • Ensure projects are completed right the first time while maintaining high standards of craftsmanship.

Safety Leadership

  • Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations and company safety policies.
  • Identify, communicate, and eliminate job-site hazards.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional work environment.

Communication & Relationships

  • Serve as the primary field contact for Project Managers and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate project progress, manpower needs, schedule impacts, and potential risks.
  • Build strong working relationships with customers, subcontractors, inspectors, and fellow team members.
  • Represent Optiline professionally on every job site.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 2 years of drywall and/or metal framing experience.
  • Minimum 2 years in a Foreman, Crew Lead, or supervisory role.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret blueprints and construction drawings.
  • Experience leading crews of 5–20+ employees.
  • Knowledge of OSHA safety standards and construction best practices.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to work full-time in active construction environments.

Preferred

  • Experience in commercial construction and retail exterior projects.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 Certification.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish).
  • Experience with production tracking, scheduling, and field management software.
  • Multi-state construction experience.
  • Experience managing fast-paced, high-volume projects.

The Optiline Foreman

A successful Foreman at Optiline demonstrates our core values every day

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, climb ladders, and work in varying weather conditions.

Why Join Optiline?

  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Family-oriented culture
  • Opportunity to work on exciting commercial and residential projects
  • A company committed to helping employees grow professionally and personally

Optiline will conduct a crimimal background check for this position upon offer acceptance.

• 적극적인 영업과 고객 지원을 위한 올바른 태도와 행동을 지닌 사람
• 고객의 행동에 대한 이해를 갖춘 사람
• 이케아 방식의 판매에 대한 지침을 이해하고 적극 사용할 수 있는 사람
• 서비스 상품을 포함한 이케아 제품에 대한 지식을 갖춘 사람
• 기본적인 제품 진열 노하우를 갖춘 사람
• 적극적인 영업 능력을 갖춘 사람
• 고객 만족을 창출하는 능력을 갖춘 사람
• 자신감 있게 사람들에게 다가가 공손하고 친근하게 대화를 거는 능력을 갖춘 사람

책임과 의무

• 도움이 필요한 고객에게 적극 접근해 적절한 질문을 통해 요구 사항을 파악하고 고객의 기대를 뛰어넘는 최적의 솔루션을 조언합니다.
• 다양한 이케아 영업 및 커뮤니케이션 채널을 사용하는 방법과 다양한 고객을 상대하는 노하우를 파악합니다.
• 담당 구역을 청결하고 정돈된 상태로 관리하고 가격을 올바르게 기재하며 충분한 재고 물량을 유지합니다.
• 고객에게 긍정적인 쇼핑 경험을 선사하기 위해 항상 이케아 표준을 준수합니다.
• 이케아 제품에 대한 열정을 가지고 제품의 기능과 이점을 적극적으로 고객 및 동료와 나눕니다.
• 매장과 부서의 실행 계획을 이해하고 부서의 목표를 달성하는 데 기여합니다.
• 이케아 매장에서 제공되는 모든 서비스를 적극적으로 제안하여 고객이 충분한 정보를 바탕으로 합리적인 선택을 할 수 있도록 만족스러운 쇼핑 경험을 제공합니다.
• 매장 전반에서 계획된 판촉 활동의 실행을 리딩하거나 지원합니다.
• 재고가 많은 제품 / 주력 제품 판매에 적극 힘써 수익성을 유지하면서 매출을 극대화 합니다.
• 판매 공간을 분석 및 조정하여 제품 물량을 충분하게 확보합니다.
• 이케아의 지속 가능한 성장과 환경에 기여합니다.

한 팀이 되어 함께하기

이케아는 프로세스 중심 조직으로서 비즈니스를 개발하고 여러 부서와 함께 성과를 창출합니다.
이케아는 모든 접점에서 많은 사람들에게 우수한 품질의 제품을 쉽고 편리하게 쇼핑할 수 있는 경험을 제공하는 데 주력하고 있습니다.

문의나 도움이 필요하세요? 연락해 주세요!

내부 지원자의 경우 지원 전 라인 매니저와 얘기해주세요. 채용 과정의 일환으로 라인 매니저에게 레퍼런스 확인이 진행될 예정입니다.
만약 이전에 이케아에서 근무한 경험이 있다면, 지원서에 이 사실을 명시해야 합니다. 저희는 또한 귀하의 이전 이케아 조직에 연락하여 추천서를 요청할 수도 있습니다. 면접은 순차적으로 진행될 예정이며, 적합한 지원자가 발견될 경우 명시된 마감일보다 일찍 채용 절차가 종료될 수 있음을 알려드립니다.

채용과 관련하여 궁금한 사항은 recruit.ikea.kr@ingka.ikea.com 로 문의 해 주세요.

채용 시 참고사항

당사는 「국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률」 및 「장애인고용촉진 및 직업재활법」에 따라 보훈 대상자와 장애인에게 채용 전형에서 우대 혜택을 제공합니다. 관련 법령에 따른 대상자는 지원 시 해당 사항을 기재해 주시기 바랍니다.

최종 합격하여 채용이 결정된 경우 근로관계 개시일부터 3개월의 *시용기간이 진행됩니다. 다만, 1회에 한해 3개월 이내에서 연장될 수 있습니다. (*시용기간은 수습기간을 의미)

서류 반환 정책

* 본 고지는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』 제11조 제6항에 따른 것입니다.
* 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.

* 채용서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용서류 반환청구서[채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제3호 서식]를 작성하여 당사 이메일 recruit.ikea.kr@ingka.ikea.com 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.

* 당사는 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

title: Vice President, AI Strategy (New York)
description:
Company description

Publicis Groupe is a global leader in communication and is positioned at every step of the value chain, from consulting to execution, combining marketing transformation and digital business transformation. Through a unified and fluid organization, Publicis Groupe partners with its clients across communication, media, data and technology to ensure access to the full breadth of capabilities in every market. Present in over 100 countries, Publicis Groupe employs around 103,000 professionals.

Overview

The Vice President, AI Strategy drives and supports AI initiatives for the MRCL platform at Publicis Groupe, helping shape how artificial intelligence creates measurable value for the Groupe's clients and internal teams. This role sits at the intersection of technology and business, translating the fast-moving AI landscape into a coherent, actionable strategy that advances MRCL's capabilities and keeps Publicis ahead of the curve. The VP of AI Strategy works cross-functionally with engineering, data, and client-facing teams to identify opportunities, define investment priorities, and champion AI capabilities across the organization.

Responsibilities
  • Drive and support MRCL's AI strategy, defining how large language models, generative AI, and agent-based systems are prioritized and deployed across the platform
  • Identify and evaluate emerging AI technologies, research, and vendor partnerships, providing a clear point of view on what matters and why
  • Translate AI capabilities into business value propositions for internal stakeholders, clients, and Publicis leadership
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to shape the AI feature roadmap, ensuring strategic priorities are reflected in build decisions
  • Define frameworks for responsible AI use, including bias mitigation, transparency, and governance, ensuring MRCL's AI practices meet the Groupe's ethical standards
  • Represent Publicis Groupe's AI perspective in industry forums, client presentations, and thought leadership content
  • Align AI investments to measurable outcomes — efficiency gains, revenue impact, and competitive differentiation
Qualifications
  • 12+ years of experience in data, analytics, or technology roles, including 5+ years in leadership positions overseeing cross-functional teams and enterprise client delivery.
  • Strong command of the AI landscape including large language models, generative AI, and agentic systems
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to connect technology capabilities to tangible business and client outcomes
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills — able to make complex AI concepts accessible to diverse audiences
  • Experience developing responsible AI frameworks including governance, ethics, and risk management
  • Comfort operating cross-functionally across engineering, product, data, and commercial teams
  • Ability to evaluate and assess AI vendor and technology partnerships with rigor and commercial awareness
  • Thought leadership mindset with experience contributing to industry conversations and executive-level presentations
Additional information

Our Publicis Groupe motto 'Viva La Différence' means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent.

Publicis Groupe provides robust and inclusive benefit programs and policies to support the evolving and diverse needs of our talent and enable every person to grow and thrive. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off.

If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact USMSTACompliance@publicis.com.

Compensation Range: $168,150- $269,217 annually. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. Temporary roles may also qualify for participation in our 401(k) plan after eligibility criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 07/24/2026.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Veterans Encouraged to Apply.

title: Product Engineer
description:
About the Role

This is a hands-on, generalist product engineering role at an early-stage ambient intelligence startup, where you'll own the app experience end-to-end across iOS, Apple Watch, and Mac — along with the shared backend surfaces that power them. You'll work directly alongside product leadership, making real tradeoffs on the fly and shipping user-facing improvements without a fully-specified backlog. It's a rare opportunity to shape a consumer AI product from the ground up across hardware-adjacent and mobile platforms.

What You'll Do

  • Own app features end-to-end across iOS, watchOS, and Mac, working directly with product leadership without a structured backlog.

  • Build and ship user-facing improvements addressing real issues surfaced from early product use — including wearable interaction reliability, cross-platform detection, and agent responsiveness.

  • Move fluidly across UX, UI, backend, and AI/ML depending on what each feature needs, making scope and design tradeoffs independently.

  • Integrate agent and LLM-based features — including tool use, memory, and retrieval — directly into the app experience.

  • Collaborate with an ASR Engineer on shared backend and pipeline surfaces.

  • Take features from design through ship through iteration based on real user feedback, without waiting for the next instruction.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years shipping consumer product features end-to-end across at least two platforms (mobile, desktop, wearable, or backend).

  • Proficiency in Swift/SwiftUI for iOS and watchOS, with shipped apps to show for it.

  • Comfort with Electron and web technologies (TypeScript/React) for the Mac client.

  • Genuine, demonstrated capability across UX, UI, backend, and AI/ML — not deep in one and dabbling in the rest.

  • Experience building and integrating agent/LLM-based features (tool use, memory, retrieval) into production consumer applications.

  • Backend development experience building shared services and APIs across multiple client surfaces.

  • Prior experience as one of the first engineers at an early-stage or pre-launch startup, shipping with minimal specification.

  • Track record of making independent UX and scope decisions and implementing them directly without handoff.

  • Nice to have: experience with real-time or streaming systems (audio processing, live data pipelines); prior work at an AI-native consumer app; wearable, hardware, or robotics product background.

Location

Hybrid (3 days/week in office) — San Francisco Bay Area, California. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

title: Product Manager - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Neobank App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Assembler
description:
Assembler

Department: Assembly
Reports To: Assembly Director
Location: Assembly Department
Job Type: Full-Time

About the Position

We are looking for a dependable and detail-oriented Assembler to join our Assembly Department. The Assembler is responsible for assembling, inspecting, adjusting, and packaging customer products according to established work instructions and quality standards.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, can follow written and verbal instructions, and takes pride in producing quality work. This position requires teamwork, flexibility, and the ability to work efficiently while maintaining safety and quality standards.

What You'll Do

  • Assemble customer products and assemblies according to work instructions, diagrams, and specifications.
  • Inspect completed assemblies to ensure they meet quality standards.
  • Adjust and correct assemblies as needed.
  • Package completed products for shipment.
  • Read and follow written work instructions.
  • Use a variety of hand and power tools, including nut drivers, screw guns, screwdrivers, mallets, small sanders, air guns, air drivers, air staplers, and pallet jacks.
  • Receive and inventory raw materials.
  • Complete packing lists and shipping documentation accurately.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.
  • Follow proper lifting and material-handling procedures.
  • Follow all safety procedures, including hazardous material storage and emergency procedures.
  • Know and follow fire, chemical spill, severe weather, and building evacuation procedures.
  • Work cooperatively with team members and supervisors.
  • Cross-train in other areas of the Assembly Department as needed.
  • Report questionable product, quality, safety, or work conditions to management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Ability to read and understand simple written instructions, work instructions, diagrams, correspondence, and memos.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and supervisors.
  • Basic math skills, including addition, subtraction, and multiplication.
  • Ability to use common sense and good judgment when following written, verbal, or diagrammed instructions.
  • Good hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Dependable, flexible, and willing to learn multiple jobs within the department.
  • Previous manufacturing or assembly experience is helpful, but not required.

Physical Requirements

This position involves medium to heavy physical work and requires the ability to:

  • Stand for most of the work shift.
  • Perform repetitive movements with the hands and upper extremities.
  • Frequently grasp, handle, and manipulate small parts.
  • Demonstrate good hand, finger, and eye coordination.
  • Operate hand tools, power tools, air tools, and a pallet jack.
  • Work at a rapid pace when required by customer demand.
  • Lift up to 80 pounds occasionally, 50 pounds frequently, and 20 pounds constantly.
  • Follow proper lifting and material-handling techniques.

Work Environment

  • Clean and organized assembly/manufacturing environment.
  • Standing is required for most of the workday.
  • Anti-fatigue mats are available for employee comfort.
  • May be exposed to warmer temperatures during the summer months.
  • Occasional overtime may be required based on customer demand and production volume.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support our employees both at work and at home. Benefits include:

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee Training and Cross-Training Opportunities
  • Opportunities for Growth and Advancement

Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan terms.

Join Our Team

If you are dependable, hardworking, and enjoy hands-on work, this is an opportunity to become an important part of our Assembly team. We provide training and cross-training to help employees learn multiple areas of the department and become successful in their roles.

Apply today and become part of our team!

Post offer pre-employment drug test required.

You’ll assist in leading your team with care and purpose, ensuring every guest feels welcome and every department looks its best. You’ll work side by side with your team and manager, teaching and coaching them to grow while celebrating their successes. You’ll keep things running smoothly, solve problems quickly, and step in as acting manager when needed. This role reports to the Produce & Floral Department Manager and embodies a culture of leadership, hospitality, excellence, and teamwork.

The pay range for this position is $15.00 - $16.27 per hour.

What You'll Do:

  • Assist in maintaining accurate inventory levels, minimizing shrink, and supporting ordering processes.
  • Act as a resource for team members and provide guidance in the manager’s absence.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
About the Role

This is the single technical thread from first discovery call through to a customer operating in production. Sitting within the Commercial Organization, the Senior Solutions Engineer bridges pre-sales and delivery — owning the solution design that underpins the commercial proposal and staying accountable through go-live. That continuity is the point.

What You'll Do

  • Discovery: Run technical and process discovery with customers across supply chain, quality, logistics, and IT — uncovering current-state workflows, data sources, systems, and constraints.

  • Pre-sales: Deliver tailored demonstrations mapped to the customer's own lanes, products, and release processes — not a standard script — and handle technical objections in the room.

  • Solutioning: Own the initial solution design and solution map: which modules apply, what data is required, which integrations are in play, what is phased, and what is out of scope.

  • Scoping: Translate solution designs into sequenced statements of work and implementation plans, sizing effort honestly and surfacing long-lead items before they become commitments.

  • Commercial support: Partner with Sales leadership on proposals and order forms, ensuring everything committed commercially is technically deliverable.

  • Delivery: Carry your design into delivery — lead solution workshops, guide configuration of lane qualification, command center, and automated product release modules, and stay accountable through go-live.

  • Cross-functional coordination: Sequence deliverables and manage technical handoffs across Product, Data, and Engineering while feeding real customer patterns back into the roadmap.

  • Repeatability: Build reusable assets — reference solution designs, discovery question banks, scoping templates, and integration patterns — that make the next deal faster.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager delivering enterprise software implementations end-to-end

  • Proven ability to run technical discovery with cross-functional stakeholders (supply chain, quality, logistics, IT) and translate requirements into solution designs

  • Track record owning solution designs from pre-sales through implementation and go-live

  • Experience scoping and sequencing implementation plans, sizing effort, and identifying dependencies

  • Proficiency delivering customer-tailored product demonstrations and handling technical objections in sales situations

  • Domain experience in supply chain, cold chain, logistics, or quality management systems and workflows

  • Hands-on experience configuring or implementing enterprise software modules (e.g., product release management, qualification systems, command/control platforms)

  • Proficiency with design and documentation tools (Figma, FigJam, or equivalent) and project tracking systems (Linear, Jira, or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with data integration patterns, API-driven architectures, or system interoperability challenges is a plus

  • Experience in regulated industries (pharma, food, healthcare) with compliance and traceability requirements is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range: $140,000 – $180,000 USD annually.

Location

On-site in Boston, Massachusetts, USA.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Drata is building the trust layer between great companies - automating compliance, managing risk, and helping organizations prove trust continuously as they scale. We're Dratanauts: a global crew of 600+ professionals united by a culture that rewards integrity, ownership, and raising the bar, no matter where in the world we're working from.

Why Join the Drata Team?
At Drata, you're not maintaining legacy compliance software - you're building the agentic AI platform defining what trust looks like for the next generation of companies. Here's what makes the work itself worth showing up for:

  • Problems without a playbook: You'll work at the edge of AI and security, building agentic governance, continuous compliance, and real-time trust verification to solve problems that don't have an established answer yet. You're writing it as you go.

  • Real ownership, not just process: Our values center on owning outcomes and raising the bar, not checking boxes. You're expected to have opinions and back them.

  • A seat at the table: Your perspective is unique and valued. Open debate and diverse viewpoints are built into how decisions actually get made here, at every level.

  • Growth at rocketship speed: Drata is scaling fast, which means scope grows fast too. High performers get more ownership, visibility, and experience.

  • A crew, not just coworkers: Dratanauts consistently describe a "come as you are" culture with sharp, curious people—the kind of team that makes hard problems genuinely fun to solve. See what they say here and follow us on LinkedIn for company news, employee stories, and career updates.

Job Summary:

The Senior Product Manager is a key position to support our growth, and we are looking for an experienced product manager to join us! As the Senior Product Manager, you will be working cross-functionally to design, build, and roll-out products and features that align with Drata’s strategy and vision. A top-notch senior product manager will have worked on numerous projects and have a firm grasp of how to satisfy consumers’ needs. Ideal candidates will be equally analytical and creative, and able to justify decisions to a range of stakeholders. This is an ideal position for someone who thrives in changing environments and can build the roadmap to create innovative product offerings.

What you’ll do:

  • Define roadmap and requirements to solve big customers problems in the Enterprise space

  • Define an MVP experience and quickly learn and iterate based on feedback

  • Form hypotheses and run experiments using lean methodologies

  • Partner closely with engineering and design teams to define, build, and maintain products/features which are critical to growth and retention

  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams on release plans and documentation to deliver value to our customers

  • Proactively partner across teams to anticipate and address risks and dependencies

  • Communicate progress and plan to leadership, peers, etc.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years designing and delivering world-class software products in a Product Management role

  • Deep customer empathy

  • Passion for identifying and solving problems with the ability to conduct effective customer interviews

  • Capable of breaking down a big vision into small deliverables

  • Ruthless prioritization of the backlog

  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset and the drive to pursue opportunities beyond current constraints

  • Exceptional collaboration skills working with PMs, engineers, designers, marketers, and customer success teams

  • Growth mindset with a desire for continuous improvement

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong analytical skills paired with a data-informed mindset

  • Experience launching a new product offering from 0-1 strongly preferred

  • Experience building complex products for Enterprise customers strongly preferred

  • Experience in the Procurement, Vendors, Third-Party Risk or Risk space strongly preferred

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

  • Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

The Senior Import Compliance Program Manager is responsible for leading diagnostics-level import compliance programs that reduce tariff exposure, strengthen internal controls and harmonize import practices across Danaher Diagnostics operating companies. This role will own strategic tariff mitigation initiatives, lead technical import escalations related to classification, country of origin and import program harmonization.

This position reports to the Director, Trade Compliance and is part of the Danaher Diagnostics Trade Compliance team and will be fully remote.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead strategic tariff mitigation programs across diagnostic operating companies, including opportunity identification, execution tracking, savings validation and leadership-ready reporting.
  • Serve as a diagnostics-level escalation point for technical import matters, including tariff classification, country of origin analysis, customs valuation, special programs, import documentation and harmonized implementation of import processes.
  • Monitor trade regulatory changes and maintain related procedures, documentation, KPIs and reporting to drive timely updates and visibility to program health, savings, control gaps and escalations.
  • Strengthen import internal controls by validating practices against approved procedures, coordinating self-testing and ensuring corrective actions are tracked to closure.
  • Oversee tariff refund, recovery and post-entry activities while partnering with OpCo trade teams, finance, sourcing, logistics, legal and advisors to drive consistent import compliance execution across the diagnostics platform.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, international trade, finance, law, or a related field preferred (or equivalent work experience) with 10+ years of progressive experience in U.S. import compliance, customs brokerage, trade compliance, or related areas.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on HTS classification, country of origin, import internal controls and customs program requirements in a complex, multi-site or matrixed organization.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects or programs involving tariff mitigation, duty recovery, post-entry actions, internal controls or import process harmonization.
  • Experience developing or maintaining compliance procedures, technical documentation, metrics, KPIs, dashboards or leadership reporting for import compliance programs.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 10-15% domestically or internationally, as business needs require.
  • Primarily remote work environment; no routine physical requirements beyond standard computer-based work.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Diagnostics, medical devices, life sciences, biotechnology or other regulated industry experience.
  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) credential and advanced use of ACE, Power BI, or other trade compliance analytics tools.
  • Danaher Business System, lean, continuous improvement or formal project management methodology.

title: Sr. Director - Digital Solutions Delivery (MIM)
description:
Job Description Summary

The Sr. Director, Digital Solutions Delivery (MIM) is responsible for leading the operational strategy, governance, performance management, and scalability of MIM's implementation organization, ensuring customer deployments are delivered efficiently, predictably, and in alignment with commercial growth objectives.

Job Description

GE HealthCare's MIM business is seeking a strategic and operationally focused leader to serve as Director, Digital Solutions Delivery.

This role is responsible for driving operational excellence across the implementation lifecycle, ensuring customer deployments are delivered predictably, efficiently, and at scale. The Director will own the systems, governance, performance metrics, resource strategies, and continuous improvement initiatives that enable successful implementation outcomes across the MIM portfolio.

Working across Commercial Delivery, Customer Success, Clinical Solutions, Workflow Engineering, Product Management, Engineering, and Sales, this leader will establish the operational framework that transforms implementation from a project execution function into a scalable business capability that accelerates customer value realization and supports long-term revenue growth. This role is focused on operational leadership, organizational effectiveness, and business performance rather than day-to-day project management.

Essential Responsibilities

Delivery Operations Leadership

  • Lead the operational strategy and performance of the implementation organization across all MIM products and solutions.

  • Establish scalable delivery frameworks that drive execution excellence, customer outcomes, and long-term business growth.

  • Partner with senior leadership to align implementation capabilities with commercial objectives and customer commitments.

Performance & KPI Ownership

  • Own implementation performance metrics and drive improvements in delivery efficiency, time-to-value, throughput, resource utilization, and customer readiness.

  • Lead operational reviews using data-driven insights to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve organizational performance.

  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.

Resource Planning & Capacity Management

  • Lead workforce planning, capacity management, and resource allocation strategies to support business demand.

  • Partner across Commercial Delivery, Customer Success, Product, and Operations teams to align delivery capacity with organizational priorities.

  • Identify and address operational bottlenecks that could impact delivery performance or customer outcomes.

Process Excellence & Operational Governance

  • Own implementation methodologies, governance frameworks, SOPs, operational tooling, and best practices.

  • Drive standardization and adoption of processes that improve scalability, consistency, and customer experience.

  • Ensure operational systems, reporting, and implementation data support effective decision-making and execution.

People & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and develop high-performing teams focused on execution excellence and customer success.

  • Foster strong partnerships across Sales, Customer Success, Clinical Solutions, Workflow Engineering, Product Management, Engineering, and Operations.

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex operational challenges and drive alignment toward successful business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • 10+ years of experience leading project delivery, implementation operations, professional services, clinical operations, PMO, or related functions.

  • 5+ years of progressive people leadership experience, including managing managers and/or large cross-functional organizations.

  • Demonstrated success driving operational excellence, organizational transformation, and process improvement initiatives.

  • Experience developing performance metrics, executive dashboards, and operational reporting frameworks.

  • Strong background in forecasting, capacity planning, resource utilization, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Proven ability to influence at all levels of an organization and lead through collaboration.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within healthcare IT, healthcare software, medical technology, SaaS, or enterprise software organizations.

  • Familiarity with implementation methodologies, customer onboarding, customer success, or professional services organizations.

  • Experience leading large-scale operational transformation initiatives.

  • Experience leveraging operational analytics to drive business performance.

Success Measures

Within the first 12–18 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Improve implementation throughput and delivery predictability.

title: Payment Operations & Risk Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Joybuy is JD.com’s dedicated retail platform for Europe, offering products across a wide range of categories. Operating across the UK, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium and Luxembourg, we’re building the future of retail through smart systems, bold ideas, and a customer-first mindset. Backed by JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, and its trusted global technology and supply chain ecosystem, we deliver a shopping experience that is speedy, reliable, and genuinely enjoyable. If you’re ready to make a difference, bring your talent and grow with us. Don’t just buy, Joybuy.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://about.joybuy.com/about/

What We Offer

Joining Joybuy means becoming part of a business where people, innovation, and impact work together to shape the future of cross-border e-commerce. You’ll contribute to smart supply chains, efficient logistics, and meaningful projects that drive real customer value. With a competitive salary, great office locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to grow your career, learn from talented colleagues, and make a genuine impact in a fast-expanding international business.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the Joybuy team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

We are seeking a data-driven and analytical Payment Operations & Risk Analyst to monitor, optimize, and protect our global payment ecosystem. In this role, you will be the frontline investigator tracking payment performance, mitigating fraud, and identifying areas to improve cost efficiency. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Risk teams, translating complex transaction data into actionable improvements that safeguard company funds and enhance customer experience. If you love solving data puzzles, mapping out technical user journeys, and supporting international scaling, this role is for you.

What you will do:

  • Order & Payment Scheme Design and Implementation
    Focus on the full-chain of cross-border e-commerce order transactions; lead the business solution design for platform transaction payments, order settlement, and receivables/collection disbursement.
    Deeply adapt to cross-border platform trading rules; deliver standardized transaction payment & settlement solutions tailored to different merchants, transaction scenarios and order types, supporting the scaled and standardized expansion of platform order transaction business.

  • Transaction Payment System Requirements & Development
    Deeply participate in iterative development and functional optimization of the order transaction payment system; focus on core transaction payment scenarios.
    Take charge of business-side requirements research, transaction link flow mapping, and payment process design; independently output business solutions and collaborate with product, R&D and risk control teams to deliver core capabilities.

  • Payment Service & Process Optimization
    Continuously review and address pain points across the end-to-end order transaction payment chain.
    Run dedicated optimization initiatives targeting key issues, including transaction payment failures, abnormal order settlement, delayed collection, stuck funds, transaction rejections, and compensation/dispute handling.
    Iterate on the transaction payment operational processes to drive up the overall order transaction success rate.

  • Cross-departmental Project Execution
    Coordinate with business, operations, risk control and technical teams to drive dedicated optimization projects for order transaction payment and settlement.
    Follow the full lifecycle of requirements review, system development, feature testing, pilot (gray) launch, acceptance and iteration to ensure the payment system capability matches the platform's order transaction business growth rhythm.

  • Transaction Data Review & Best-practice Accumulation
    Own monitoring and control of core payment data metrics, including transaction success rate, settlement timeliness, and abnormal transactions ratio.
    Complete issue attribution and performance review; issue regular transaction payment analysis reports.
    Accumulate standardized cross-border order transaction payment solutions, risk handling case studies chers, and best practices.

About you:

  • Experience: 2-5 years of experience in payment operations, data analytics, fraud risk management, or a closely related role within fintech or e-commerce.

  • Payment Knowledge: Solid understanding of the fundamental payment lifecycle, including gateways, acquiring, card schemes, chargebacks, and settlements.

  • Data Proficiency: Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience querying and visualizing transaction data (using SQL, Excel, Tableau, or Power BI).

  • Risk Awareness: Familiarity with online fraud detection concepts, chargeback processes, and risk mitigation tools (e.g., 3D Secure, risk scoring).

  • Cross-Border Exposure: Basic understanding of multi-currency transactions, international payment processing, or alternative payment methods (APMs) is a plus.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Ability to clearly communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams, including engineering, risk, and product managers.

  • Detail-Oriented Problem Solver: A proactive mindset with an eye for detail, capable of spotting a subtle trend shift in large datasets before it becomes a widespread issue.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Systems Navigator (SN) - Fort Riley, KS**

The EFMP is a mandatory enrollment program that works with other military and civilian agencies to provide comprehensive and coordinated community support, housing, educational, medical, and personnel services to Families with special needs. Soldiers on active duty enroll in the program when they have a Family member with special medical and/or education needs requiring specialized services. EFMP ensures that a family member's needs are considered during the military personnel assignment process so their needs can be considered during the military personnel assignment process.


Systems Navigators and ACS Compliance Specialists (SNACS) - Exceptional Family Member Program (EFMP) - Systems Navigator (SN)


System Navigators are responsible for daily coordination to ensure the facilitation of networking between Families who have special needs and the systems of required care. Duties of the position include intake interviews and documentation, identification needs assessment of the Family member, referrals, follow-up care and information, advocacy, and collaboration with providers in both the civilian and military community.

  • Coordinate with Government agencies and civilian service providers to identify the availability of non-EFMP respite care resources.
  • Maintain an information catalog of national, state, and local networks and contacts with military and civilian service providers who offer assistance to families with special needs.
  • Coordinate a support group and/ or workshops monthly.
  • Present EFMP Systems Navigation briefings to provide Soldiers and Family members an overview of available EFMP related services.
  • Provide information and referral services to Families by identifying appropriate resources and helping them make an informed choice of services available.
  • Partners with Families to increase resilience, develop self-advocacy skills, and improve their ability to navigate systems effectively.
  • Manage the Soldiers and Family member records in accordance with all required Army and DoD regulations.
  • Facilitate warm hand off to the appropriate program personnel when transitions occur.
  • Collects and explores data for planning, reporting, and program improvement, completed monthly reports meeting program deadlines.
  • Implements policies, procedures, and practices that connect Families to support services.

Required Skills/Qualifications

  • Knowledge of human service principles and practices, individual Family needs and problems relative to case management.
  • Knowledge of military, state and Federal laws, policies, regulations, and practices regarding medical, educational, and Family support services.
  • Possess skill levels to provide professional non-clinical case management services, facilitating connections between Families who have special needs and the systems of required care.

  • Level 1 Life Coach certified through Certified Life Coach Institute (Provided by Patriot).
  • Must be able to travel.

Davidson Technology are working with a large Regional Council to supply a Penetration Tester to support the Cyber Security and ICT Governance Service through a large program of work on an initial 12-month contract with the option of 2 x 1-year extensions.

As a Penetration Tester, you will provide specialist cybersecurity assurance and technical security testing to support a Regional Council in strengthening its cyber maturity, ICT governance and operational resilience. You will assess Council’s ICT environment for vulnerabilities and security weaknesses through structured penetration testing and security assurance activities, identifying potential attack paths, validating the effectiveness of existing security controls and providing clear, risk-based recommendations for remediation. You will demonstrate strong capability across vulnerability assessment, security testing, threat analysis and reporting, supported by excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to work collaboratively with internal ICT teams, managed service providers and third-party vendors. Relevant industry certifications such as OSCP, CREST, GPEN or equivalent will be highly regarded. Northern Health is the major provider of acute, maternity, sub-acute, mental health, specialist, community and home-based services in Melbourneâs rapidly growing outer north.

About the Role:

This role is a technical position within the Clinical Digital Innovation team, supporting the establishment of a clinical analytics databaseâ that will underpin research, quality improvement, and clinical analytics at Northern Health.

The successful candidate will work directly under the supervision of the Director, Clinical Digital Innovation, who provides informatics leadership and clinical governance oversight for the programme.

Â

The core technical workflow involves extracting data from the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) via ODBC connections, loading it into the local Data Warehouse (DWH), pushing to AWS S3 cloud storage, and transforming data into a simplified OMOP common data model.

Â

This is a hands-on data pipeline role: the right candidate is comfortable working with real-world messy health data, has a methodical approach to data quality and documentation, and is willing to learn health informatics concepts on the job with mentorship and informatics leadership.

Â

This role does not require prior experience in clinical informatics or OMOP â structured mentorship and informatics leadership are provided.

  • Understanding of data warehousing principles â staging vs. curated data layers, incremental vs. full loads, and the importance of data lineage and transformation documentation
  • Demonstrated attention to data quality: understands that missing, duplicate, or poorly coded data is the norm in clinical systems, and approaches data cleaning with rigour and documentation
  • Comfortable using AI coding and productivity tools (e.g. Claude Code) in a responsible, transparent, and accountable manner â understands their strengths and limitations and reviews AI-generated output before relying on it
  • Understands the data structures, formats, and quality norms required to support AI and machine-learning modelling â and how upstream data decisions affect downstream model reliability
  • Reliable and accountable: follows through on assigned tasks, seeks clarification proactively, documents work clearly, and takes responsibility for testing outputs before handover
  • Familiarity with healthcare data models and standards such as ICD-10 or OMOP are desirable but not required

title: AVP Special Assets
